Friend -- Are you on other political email lists?

If so, you probably receive urgent and breathless emails asking for money on a daily basis. Too many politicians and organizations see their grassroots supporters as an ATM machine. They use fear, guilt, shame, and often downright lies to convince people to donate.

The trend was already bad, but was sent into hyperdrive by the Trump campaign. Unfortunately, both major parties have adopted his tactics because, sadly, they're quite effective. But I'm determined to rise above that and treat you and the others in our movement with respect. Here’s what Country First believes:

\- Instead of scaring you to donate, I want to inspire you to take action.

\- Instead of guilt tripping you for not donating enough, I want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative, educational content.

\- Instead of misleading you about fake 5X matches or faux threats, I'm honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help.

\- Instead of only hitting you up when _Country First_ needs money, I also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and charitable causes (our Afghan Ally Relief Fund and Stand with Ukraine Fund are huge successes).

But Friend, we aren't just focused on highlighting the problem and then holding our hand out. Instead: \- We're proactively fighting to save our democracy in places like Michigan, where MAGA is poised to take over the state if we don't intervene (we've deployed a team and are mobilizing tons of volunteers to do just that). \- We're making the key difference in races across the country by dropping mail, ads, and texts to turn out Republicans, Democrats, and Independents in races where MAGA would otherwise win. \- We're building a community that allows good people to come together to discover there's nothing Americans can't overcome when the reasonable majority bands together. \- And we're forcefully calling out the liars and cheaters who are working daily to tear us apart.

Friend, I'm about to make an audacious request. Would it be crazy to ask you to invest just $3, $6, or $9 today? Any donation, no matter the size, ads up to a big difference and helps us fund our bold [Primary First](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=2) initiative and other exciting programs in the works. We’d really appreciate it. | [](https://www.country1st.com/donate?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=3 "Contribute $3, $6, $9 or whatever you can

So, maybe you can’t donate right now. But maybe you’ll get something of value, like our 1/6 Digest below, from reading my emails. Or perhaps you’ll [take action as a volunteer](https://www.country1st.com/get_involved?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=4) or [join our private troll-free Facebook Community](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=5).

## 1/6 Committee Digest
Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. **MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING:** **TENTATIVELY THURSDAY, JULY 21** **In Case You Missed It:**
* Rep. Kinzinger [appeared](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRbZly1XyQAxvl8lUi1lQBAh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=6) with Wolf Blitzer to discuss the 1/6 Committee’s findings
* Rep. Kinzinger [spoke](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRbtGadM3PzEJv0NFc5S3mBb&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=7) to ABC about new witnesses coming forward

**Who Gave Testimony:**
* **Jason Van Tatenhove** , Former Oath Keepers Spokesman
* **Stephen Ayres** , Convicted Rioter

* * *
Here are the major developments from the committee: **Former Oath Keepers’ Spokesperson Testified That January 6th Could Have Been More Disastrous and Fears for Future Elections** The 1/6 Committee heard testimony on Tuesday from Jason Van Tatenhove, a former spokesperson for the Oath Keepers, a far-right, anti-government militia group. Because of the time Van Tatenhove spent with the group, he knew of the violence it encouraged. January 6th could have been much [worse](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=_5K3Y2C-6ajomPfZ3po6UZRinfyYxNK58PRD9Wqk42MXsxoz3hD8HERHlQNzIZObemy_augXQ1wqFxI1sTotJxelWQ0338ozo94yU2qpH11lUNyOMfXC-vg-t5ylqq6r&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=8), according to Van Tatenhove, because of the Oath Keepers’ militia mindset. "They may not like to call themselves a militia, but they are, they’re a violent militia," he testified to the 1/6 Committee. He stated that the violent attack that unfolded on January 6th was representative of the Oath Keepers, and that he believes them to be a "very dangerous organization." Van Tatenhove also testified about his fear for the future of American democracy, expressing concern that, if Donald Trump were to run again in 2024, his rhetoric could again cause extremist groups to take action, or be called to even more violence. **Convicted Capitol Rioter Summoned by Trump** Stephen Ayres, a convicted Capitol rioter, expressed his reasoning for attending the January 6th "Stop the Steal" rally that devolved into a deadly, coordinated attack on the Capitol building. After [continuously](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GmrkqIvTVM5Gw19P8OEWnqPAtIHhAMxU89vlTUXNYDYdBfLR99Yr6pRt7AQx_OjcoP32B1Hi3aE8NSXfJXcR8P1BNjjIks-vVBzyP6ZnzYegjikpXZfsKwVllpHYdfdfi3cXpqUEHjNNUsVXFoi1swp3NBrURdwEzfUk2dOQ3s4&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=9) listening to the lies of the former president, Ayres said, "I felt like I needed to be down here." Ayres, who has been convicted of illegally entering the United States Capitol building on January 6th, spoke of the damage done to his life by his decision to attend the rally, which included losing his job, his reputation, and nearly his family because of the lies of the former president. He also testified that he did not expect to go to the Capitol that day, but [was](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GmrkqIvTVM5Gw19P8OEWnqPAtIHhAMxU89vlTUXNYDYdBfLR99Yr6pRt7AQx_OjcoP32B1Hi3aE8NSXfJXcR8P1BNjjIks-vVBzyP6ZnzYegjikpXZfsKwVllpHYdfdfi3cXpqUEHjNNUsVXFoi1swp3NBrURdwEzfUk2dOQ3s4&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=10) "following what [Trump] said." Although he is not, and was never, a member of a far-right extremist group like the Oath Keepers or the Proud Boys, he said he felt comfortable marching with them because it felt like they were on his side. Ayers has since left social media and has expressed remorse for his role in the tragic day, urging people to "take the blinders off. Make sure you step back and see what’s going on. Before it’s too late." Ayers is currently awaiting sentencing. **Former Twitter Employee Speaks Out Against Twitter’s Inaction Regarding Trump’s Rhetoric** The 1/6 Committee shared audio of an interview the Committee conducted with a former Twitter employee. Remaining anonymous, the phone call interview revealed the nervous buzz at Twitter due to the former president’s rhetoric. In the interview, the employee stated that there were those at Twitter who were unnerved by Trump’s [language](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GUadKUZbNtXpoQtrN7XiLlDAp0T1nvsEvUIUmB084zF_cM-nYKyLRIWC-N2z1JCSiBm6U8xwidoL3ZFt-Cmo1ZwiVjiPFyX95BR9YzUq1cidZfBqXc3N7XhcwnuFoQYiuAkOTiYTov8r9uldB9Sltw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=11) surrounding the 2020 election. This verbiage resulted in users on Twitter answering with obvious and strong intentions of going to the Capitol on January 6th to "Stop the Steal" through the use of violence, especially after Trump tweeted on December 19th that said "Be there, will be wild!" As Trump continued to tweet about "stopping the steal" and encouraging his supporters to join him at a rally on January 6th, the employee stated that Twitter did not take action to suspend his account, even though it was clear there was a risk of violence. The employee then went on to say that if it was another user who had caused followers to respond with violence, their account would have been immediately suspended. The employee also felt that Twitter enjoyed the fact that they were Donald Trump’s preferred social media platform. After January 6th, Twitter finally suspended Trump’s account. **The Former President Summoned a Violent Mob, Committee Affirms** According to text messages and photos shared by the committee at Tuesday’s hearing, two of former President Trump’s trusted advisors, Michael Flynn and Roger Stone, were in contact with right-wing extremist groups the Proud Boys and the Oath Keepers, and the groups began to [work together](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GmrkqIvTVM5Gw19P8OEWnqPAtIHhAMxU89vlTUXNYDYQmyt3fftOoEcuxYqeCeVLcccPThaxw6iuVAXAjwLNarJaXjSux-Ah7SUpSJwgXOOPnxxVvUai4TQ_y0S19dPMBlqneu5vfrtSM1rBSNhyVw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=12) in the days leading up to the attack on the Capitol. The committee also focused the day’s testimony on a December 18th, 2020 Oval Office meeting. Former White House counsel Pat Cipollone stated that he arrived at a meeting where advisers Sidney Powell, Patrick Byrne, and Michael Flynn were coming up with theories of voter fraud to explain how the election was stolen. The group even went as far as suggesting that Trump should seize voting machines by declaring a state of national emergency. The meeting then reportedly devolved into a screaming match between Flynn and White House lawyer Eric Herschmann. The committee notes that this meeting was essential to proving that Trump had plans to stay in power, and is also remarkable as being the catalyst for January 6th. It was just the next day, December 19th, that Trump tweeted that his followers should amass in DC on for the "Stop the Steal" rally. **Former President Accused of Contacting Witnesses By 1/6 Committee** While the revelations in Tuesday’s hearing focused on the former president’s past decisions, Vice Chairwoman Liz Cheney used her closing remarks to call out the former president directly for attempting to intervene in the 1/6 Committee’s investigation. Cheney and the committee [allege](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=H-qEORLjmEZ0R4IEh6LC5XiIMMZLzL0JDt_4-dFf5VzY65UDuxDHxfhSpA41VVSAaBuKAzgUFgK4i0cJaJSnQg1P7R-YML-YrEKXFBIiC2fzW0yC0tAjXMKmKAh_Ffa8Vr1mRG2CwoS2bWood9RfvbcukcoupSioL3-azuZaju0&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=13) that Trump "tried to call a witness in our investigation. A witness you have not yet seen in these hearings. That person declined to answer or respond to President Trump's call and instead alerted their lawyer to the call."
Congresswoman Cheney and the committee previously warned those attempting to interrupt the investigation, but had not named any specific individuals. Congresswoman Cheney went on to [confirm](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=9j2xrPCwd3yFLU_EZoBgHvBKMxLE54FdoMr2zWqx73EzYOiQCP5gSizt_fAJG4P9Q4Gx5QH0khC_ayeuRRjnEAynfaUWff-kb1sD2j0mbOUORBWsZ6bEgZYssAhafTmK&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=14) that the Department of Justice had been notified of witness tampering by the former president, "this committee has supplied that information to the Department of Justice." After a marathon hearing, the revelation sent shock waves throughout the country. **"Unhinged" Mob Summoned as White House Aides Fret Over Trump's Rhetoric** In new video testimony and texts obtained by the 1/6 Committee, White House aides were worried about the rhetoric of the former president as he delivered a charge to an angry group of his supporters: March to the Capitol and take it back. Congressman Jamie Raskin (D-MD), outlined the aides' anxiety from the heated Oval Office meeting between Sidney Powell, Rudy Guiliani, and Overstock CEO Patrick Byrne. Official White House lawyers, speechwriters, and staff worried over Trump’s comments about then-Vice President Mike Pence. Even some of the most [loyal](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=PiInCVHjZg_Lhb0RQ-dhd3nupceIa8DuTdOzvpYk6G347coutgvOiWiRrRpyaIu_VcdaqnvGUtmwPvN2J2v_PaakrlRYVhRpOtRTzBpHgCI&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=15) Trump supporters, like former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale said "a sitting president asking for civil war... I have lost faith." On January 6th, he texted Katrina Pierson, Trump’s former spokeswoman, and said Trump’s "rhetoric killed someone." The hearing, led by Congressman Jamie Raskin (D-MD) and Congresswoman Stephanie Murphy (D-FL), provided evidence that Trump and his allies were attempting to overthrow a free and fair election by summoning some of the most violent extremist groups to the nation’s Capitol. **Sitting Members of Congress Attended Meetings on How to Overthrow a Free and Fair Election** Members of Congress [attended](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=PiInCVHjZg_Lhb0RQ-dhd3nupceIa8DuTdOzvpYk6G347coutgvOiWiRrRpyaIu_VcdaqnvGUtmwPvN2J2v_PaakrlRYVhRpOtRTzBpHgCI&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=16) a December 21, 2020 meeting at the White House to discuss something now known as the “Eastman Plan.” The plan was to pressure then-Vice President Mike Pence into delaying election certification, allowing for a new slate of “alternate electors” to keep Trump in power. Those in attendance included Matt Gaetz (R-FL), Andy Biggs (R-AZ), Louie Gohmert (R-TX), and Scottt Perry (R-PA), as well as others. White House visitor logs [confirm](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=pAuo-oXPaBx_9p32Lxxvlykf4v1tEPtw1yhBmi8C4F7yR0IGd75iVBeY4Utt8yTCmVX0n4luBb0f9dKhA2NN5SybG8lDeOpakmkkvAFToBfNr7QBcRnZRPGy04YSOBQQ&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=atm_machine_nd&n=17) this meeting in the Oval Office. In the meeting, John Eastman, a conservative lawyer, drafted a memo to give to Pence outlining how to stop the certification of votes and reinstall Trump as President.

Here’s what Country First believes: \- Instead of scaring you to donate, I want to inspire you to take action. \- Instead of guilt tripping you for not donating enough, I want our emails to provide value to you. We try to send out informative, educational content. \- Instead of misleading you about fake 5X matches or faux threats, I'm honest with you about what’s going on and how you can help. \- Instead of only hitting you up when Country First needs money, I also send you opportunities to volunteer or help other candidates and charitable causes (our Afghan Ally Relief Fund and Stand with Ukraine Fund are huge successes). But Friend, we aren't just focused on highlighting the problem and then holding our hand out. Instead: \- We're proactively fighting to save our democracy in places like Michigan, where MAGA is poised to take over the state if we don't intervene (we've deployed a team and are mobilizing tons of volunteers to do just that). \- We're making the key difference in races across the country by dropping mail, ads, and texts to turn out Republicans, Democrats, and Independents in races where MAGA would otherwise win. \- We're building a community that allows good people to come together to discover there's nothing Americans can't overcome when the reasonable majority bands together. \- And we're forcefully calling out the liars and cheaters who are working daily to tear us apart. Friend, I'm about to make an audacious request. Would it be crazy to ask you to invest just $3, $6, or $9 today? Any donation, no matter the size, ads up to a big difference and helps us fund our bold initiative and other exciting programs in the works. We’d really appreciate it. | "Contribute $3, $6, $9 or whatever you can today" If you can’t make a donation today, that’s okay too. This movement has always been rich from your moral support, and that will always be more valuable to me than money. So, maybe you can’t donate right now. But maybe you’ll get something of value, like our 1/6 Digest below, from reading my emails. Or perhaps you’ll or . No matter what, I'm glad you’re here. Thanks for being part of this movement! Country First, Adam 1/6 Committee Digest Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING: TENTATIVELY THURSDAY, JULY 21 In Case You Missed It: Rep. Kinzinger with Wolf Blitzer to discuss the 1/6 Committee’s findings Rep. Kinzinger to ABC about new witnesses coming forward Who Gave Testimony: Jason Van Tatenhove , Former Oath Keepers Spokesman Stephen Ayres , Convicted Rioter Here are the major developments from the committee: Former Oath Keepers’ Spokesperson Testified That January 6th Could Have Been More Disastrous and Fears for Future Elections The 1/6 Committee heard testimony on Tuesday from Jason Van Tatenhove, a former spokesperson for the Oath Keepers, a far-right, anti-government militia group. Because of the time Van Tatenhove spent with the group, he knew of the violence it encouraged. January 6th could have been much , according to Van Tatenhove, because of the Oath Keepers’ militia mindset. "They may not like to call themselves a militia, but they are, they’re a violent militia," he testified to the 1/6 Committee. He stated that the violent attack that unfolded on January 6th was representative of the Oath Keepers, and that he believes them to be a "very dangerous organization." Van Tatenhove also testified about his fear for the future of American democracy, expressing concern that, if Donald Trump were to run again in 2024, his rhetoric could again cause extremist groups to take action, or be called to even more violence. Convicted Capitol Rioter Summoned by Trump Stephen Ayres, a convicted Capitol rioter, expressed his reasoning for attending the January 6th "Stop the Steal" rally that devolved into a deadly, coordinated attack on the Capitol building. After listening to the lies of the former president, Ayres said, "I felt like I needed to be down here." Ayres, who has been convicted of illegally entering the United States Capitol building on January 6th, spoke of the damage done to his life by his decision to attend the rally, which included losing his job, his reputation, and nearly his family because of the lies of the former president. He also testified that he did not expect to go to the Capitol that day, but "following what [Trump] said." Although he is not, and was never, a member of a far-right extremist group like the Oath Keepers or the Proud Boys, he said he felt comfortable marching with them because it felt like they were on his side. Ayers has since left social media and has expressed remorse for his role in the tragic day, urging people to "take the blinders off. Make sure you step back and see what’s going on. Before it’s too late." Ayers is currently awaiting sentencing. Former Twitter Employee Speaks Out Against Twitter’s Inaction Regarding Trump’s Rhetoric The 1/6 Committee shared audio of an interview the Committee conducted with a former Twitter employee. Remaining anonymous, the phone call interview revealed the nervous buzz at Twitter due to the former president’s rhetoric. In the interview, the employee stated that there were those at Twitter who were unnerved by Trump’s surrounding the 2020 election. This verbiage resulted in users on Twitter answering with obvious and strong intentions of going to the Capitol on January 6th to "Stop the Steal" through the use of violence, especially after Trump tweeted on December 19th that said "Be there, will be wild!" As Trump continued to tweet about "stopping the steal" and encouraging his supporters to join him at a rally on January 6th, the employee stated that Twitter did not take action to suspend his account, even though it was clear there was a risk of violence. The employee then went on to say that if it was another user who had caused followers to respond with violence, their account would have been immediately suspended. The employee also felt that Twitter enjoyed the fact that they were Donald Trump’s preferred social media platform. After January 6th, Twitter finally suspended Trump’s account. The Former President Summoned a Violent Mob, Committee Affirms According to text messages and photos shared by the committee at Tuesday’s hearing, two of former President Trump’s trusted advisors, Michael Flynn and Roger Stone, were in contact with right-wing extremist groups the Proud Boys and the Oath Keepers, and the groups began to in the days leading up to the attack on the Capitol. The committee also focused the day’s testimony on a December 18th, 2020 Oval Office meeting. Former White House counsel Pat Cipollone stated that he arrived at a meeting where advisers Sidney Powell, Patrick Byrne, and Michael Flynn were coming up with theories of voter fraud to explain how the election was stolen. The group even went as far as suggesting that Trump should seize voting machines by declaring a state of national emergency. The meeting then reportedly devolved into a screaming match between Flynn and White House lawyer Eric Herschmann. The committee notes that this meeting was essential to proving that Trump had plans to stay in power, and is also remarkable as being the catalyst for January 6th. It was just the next day, December 19th, that Trump tweeted that his followers should amass in DC on for the "Stop the Steal" rally. Former President Accused of Contacting Witnesses By 1/6 Committee While the revelations in Tuesday’s hearing focused on the former president’s past decisions, Vice Chairwoman Liz Cheney used her closing remarks to call out the former president directly for attempting to intervene in the 1/6 Committee’s investigation. Cheney and the committee that Trump "tried to call a witness in our investigation. A witness you have not yet seen in these hearings. That person declined to answer or respond to President Trump's call and instead alerted their lawyer to the call." Congresswoman Cheney and the committee previously warned those attempting to interrupt the investigation, but had not named any specific individuals. Congresswoman Cheney went on to that the Department of Justice had been notified of witness tampering by the former president, "this committee has supplied that information to the Department of Justice." After a marathon hearing, the revelation sent shock waves throughout the country. "Unhinged" Mob Summoned as White House Aides Fret Over Trump's Rhetoric In new video testimony and texts obtained by the 1/6 Committee, White House aides were worried about the rhetoric of the former president as he delivered a charge to an angry group of his supporters: March to the Capitol and take it back. Congressman Jamie Raskin (D-MD), outlined the aides' anxiety from the heated Oval Office meeting between Sidney Powell, Rudy Guiliani, and Overstock CEO Patrick Byrne. Official White House lawyers, speechwriters, and staff worried over Trump’s comments about then-Vice President Mike Pence. Even some of the most Trump supporters, like former Trump campaign manager Brad Parscale said "a sitting president asking for civil war... I have lost faith." On January 6th, he texted Katrina Pierson, Trump’s former spokeswoman, and said Trump’s "rhetoric killed someone." The hearing, led by Congressman Jamie Raskin (D-MD) and Congresswoman Stephanie Murphy (D-FL), provided evidence that Trump and his allies were attempting to overthrow a free and fair election by summoning some of the most violent extremist groups to the nation’s Capitol. Sitting Members of Congress Attended Meetings on How to Overthrow a Free and Fair Election Members of Congress a December 21, 2020 meeting at the White House to discuss something now known as the “Eastman Plan.” The plan was to pressure then-Vice President Mike Pence into delaying election certification, allowing for a new slate of “alternate electors” to keep Trump in power. Those in attendance included Matt Gaetz (R-FL), Andy Biggs (R-AZ), Louie Gohmert (R-TX), and Scottt Perry (R-PA), as well as others. White House visitor logs this meeting in the Oval Office. In the meeting, John Eastman, a conservative lawyer, drafted a memo to give to Pence outlining how to stop the certification of votes and reinstall Trump as President. MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING: TENTATIVELY THURSDAY, JULY 21 Country First is proud to release The Weekly Digest with important updates on the 1/6 Committee's investigation of the Capitol attack. subject: Should Pro-Criminals Get Canned?
body:
Inflation continues to take a toll on Americans, as we all feel the pain from the pump to the grocery store.

# * Ballot Access*
### **Deirdre Gilbert, Gubernatorial Candidate Files Lawsuit**
**The Law is the Law!** **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE****GILBERT, INDEPENDENT GUBERNATORIAL CANDIDATE FILES LAWSUIT** HOUSTON, TEXAS, UNITED STATES, July 14, 2022--Deirdre Gilbert filed a lawsuit on July 11, 2022 in the District Court, 353rd, Judicial District, Travis County requesting the courts to step in and mandate election officials John B. Scott, Texas Secretary of State and Keith Ingram, Director of Elections to include Gilbert's name on the Official List of Approved Candidates in the November Election.Deirdre Gilbert is alleging that the Secretary of State and employee Keith Ingram, Director of Elections used their legal professions to knowingly and willingly assist in criminal and fraudulent behavior of political candidates. Gilbert states that "deceit, misrepresentation and fraud has resonated throughout the election process and that the role of the accused have played a significant role in exasperating the nightmare." Gilbert has implicated several attorneys for their failure to take further steps that would have eliminated the illegal conduct, but instead they used "willful blindness" or "deliberate ignorance", that is sanctionable under the Rules of Professional Conduct.Gilbert sees that her race for Governor has been oppressed since her first announcement, misleading voters to think that Abbott and O'Rourke are the only ones running for this position. She's read the rules and is determined to use the rules to level the playing field. Texas Election Code states that independent candidates must submit petitions that satisfy a requirement and validity, while major parties can circumvent the law by not filing a filing fee or submitting petitions, by using "ill-gotten means," or using SB 44, a bill signed by Greg Abbott on May 23, 2017, adding that a candidate petition need not be check for validity unless someone files a challenge. The problem with challenging candidates who do not meet statutory requirements is that you have to know that there is a deficiency in the first place."It's a corrupt system where Texas people won't even have the option of voting for someone outside the 2-party system," added Gilbert. "Gilbert says "she will not stop until her name is on the ballot in November."** About Deirdre Gilbert**Gilbert is an African American woman who has worked tirelessly in her community and is simply fed up with the shenanigans of the political atmosphere. She's worked on the denial of voting rights in local elections within Missouri City and MUD District issues. She has spoken before the Texas Legislature and U.S. Congress in Washington D.C on civil rights. Gilbert has helped shape legislation regarding whistleblowers, medical malpractice, and education. Deirdre Gilbert is not afraid of a battle and is willing to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves. The core of Gilbert's message is Justice for All. To connect with Gilbert, visit her online at[ https://gilbert4gov.com](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-y/); they can go to[ https://deirdre-gilbert.com](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-j/) or[ https://nmmaa.org](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-t/). Gilbert can also be followed on[ Facebook](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-i/),[ Twitter](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-d/),[ YouTube](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-h/), and[ LinkedIn](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-k/). Contact Campaign Manager at[campaignmanager@gilbert4gov.com](mailto:campaignmanager@gilbert4gov.com) [](https://gilbertforgovernor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-buhhkjd-iduiyhurdd-u/)

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zshd6vo69jufhvi9dr3nekreuqs2cgv4768pmnmg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sb5ciqj6srlmerm6s5nc1im8tj0seor5cr6c9q36dlkspoe6tjlejjbedhi6lg6fkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p3ephmcaqr9ptimhj32c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zq1m3r9p34rcl59dfmit9u3bnd3pu9cqp7cjvfq8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zs724eamd4ge6q6jgmvuh341ip0ljgiu1iapgrbg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zea785rt9gpeit16lspjrdbcklpnlddsro1sf8q0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zpcraah2poh7kov145mfv7gqiftc5csbebd326a8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z5nmtilg1nj34ucjl856jhb94ueiofa9tioq04kg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z036ghb68vfsdgjb03rfiv264fp4cc2tocsj2g98_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zo6sm8c09ro6701bvhsc6fdignvdh1p40u9jf6j0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl4arni7qt5iv2n712tdup2g0f6go08gvmptndjg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvbq60q1nj9kbllo9qaqiqt1fs3uiavkjb51sj9o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3jm9oj1cdh2bs)**

name: Zilvinas Silenas
subject: Protect kids from socialism
body:
A classroom used to be a place of learning and exploration— where children could ask questions, express opinions, and debate ideas without negative consequences. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9472%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=23m7C%2fWgDG%2fWVlPzV1NO%2bQ&sysid=1)
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bm%2fV%2bctzIUgERUbSg3%2feQ&sysid=1)

Hello Friend,

A classroom used to be a place of learning and exploration-- where children could ask questions, express opinions, and debate ideas without negative consequences.

Now, they’ve become echo chambers of Leftist indoctrination.

Kids are becoming radical activists who depend on the government and _**embrace socialism.**_

Let me introduce myself. I am Lawrence Reed, President Emeritus of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE).

FEE’s mission is to inspire, educate, and connect future leaders with the economic, ethical, and legal principles of a free society.

Our most recent effort ended with us shipping 75,000 books on free-market economics to Nevada.

I want to send another 75,000 books before the school year starts this fall. **It costs roughly $10 to print and send each book to a student.**

[_**Can you sponsor one or more students with a donation of $10, $20, $50, or any amount? Click here to send your generous gift today >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38728%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I9x0c2IqNW%2bDEtXwxzyL6Q&sysid=1)

We’re currently shipping the first 75,000 books to Nevada, so students will have the chance to read and learn from:
* 25,000 copies of _I, Pencil_ , a short book about the complexities of how making something as simple as a pencil can only be achieved in the free market.
* 25,000 copies of _Are We Rome?_ , a book about the fall of the Roman Empire.
* 25,000 copies of _Myths of the Great Depression_ , which debunks myths on government intervention solving the issue and other economic myths.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bm%2fV%2bctzIUgERUbSg3%2feQ&sysid=1)

**Pictured above and below are two FEE volunteers helping pack the first shipment of books to send to Nevada.**

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bm%2fV%2bctzIUgERUbSg3%2feQ&sysid=1)

Young Americans need to know that there is an alternative. You and I need to get in the classroom and teach the ideals of liberty and economic freedom.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bm%2fV%2bctzIUgERUbSg3%2feQ&sysid=1)

The next generation is hungry for freedom. They want their chance at the American Dream.

That’s why we work with teachers and school administration to get _**FEE in the Classroom**_.

_FEE in the Classroom’s_ one-of-a-kind educational workshops uniquely engage, inspire, and equip high school and college students with a deeper understanding of the principles of free enterprise, limited government, and entrepreneurship directly in their brick-and-mortar schools and through their virtual classes.

[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bm%2fV%2bctzIUgERUbSg3%2feQ&sysid=1)

Socialism is gaining ground once again.
* Major leaders in Congress are openly socialist (Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez), calling on 70% income taxes and a Green New Deal, which would essentially take over our economy.
* Roughly 18% of social scientists in the United States self-identify as Marxists.
* Perhaps most alarmingly, opinion polls show that more young Americans have a more positive view of socialism than capitalism.

But students are hungry for freedom and an alternative to the official narrative pushing socialism down their throats.
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38727%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m%2bm%2fV%2bctzIUgERUbSg3%2feQ&sysid=1)

_FEE in the Classroom_ provides alternatives that highlight

* The importance of personal character
* Civil and personal rights
* Economic freedom
* True history
* And so much more!

Friend, can you help us send another 75,000 books before the school year starts this fall? It costs roughly $10 to make and send a book to a student. **Click below to donate.**

Our most recent effort ended with us shipping 75,000 books on free-market economics to Nevada. I want to send another 75,000 books before the school year starts this fall. It costs roughly $10 to print and send each book to a student. We’re currently shipping the first 75,000 books to Nevada, so students will have the chance to read and learn from: 25,000 copies of I, Pencil , a short book about the complexities of how making something as simple as a pencil can only be achieved in the free market. 25,000 copies of Are We Rome? , a book about the fall of the Roman Empire. 25,000 copies of Myths of the Great Depression , which debunks myths on government intervention solving the issue and other economic myths. Pictured above and below are two FEE volunteers helping pack the first shipment of books to send to Nevada. Young Americans need to know that there is an alternative. You and I need to get in the classroom and teach the ideals of liberty and economic freedom. The next generation is hungry for freedom. They want their chance at the American Dream. That’s why we work with teachers and school administration to get FEE in the Classroom. FEE in the Classroom’s one-of-a-kind educational workshops uniquely engage, inspire, and equip high school and college students with a deeper understanding of the principles of free enterprise, limited government, and entrepreneurship directly in their brick-and-mortar schools and through their virtual classes. Socialism is gaining ground once again. Major leaders in Congress are openly socialist (Bernie Sanders and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez), calling on 70% income taxes and a Green New Deal, which would essentially take over our economy. Roughly 18% of social scientists in the United States self-identify as Marxists. Perhaps most alarmingly, opinion polls show that more young Americans have a more positive view of socialism than capitalism. But students are hungry for freedom and an alternative to the official narrative pushing socialism down their throats. FEE in the Classroom provides alternatives that highlight The importance of personal character Civil and personal rights Economic freedom True history And so much more! Friend, can you help us send another 75,000 books before the school year starts this fall? It costs roughly $10 to make and send a book to a student. Click below to donate. Thank you, ** Zilvinas Silenas President of FEE 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

In my brand-new coffee-table style book, _America Is a Christian Nation_ , you can see how our country has moved from its reliance on God to its rejection of God. It’s a short read, and we’ve paired the written content with some gorgeous patriotic photos that you’re going to enjoy looking through.

subject: Vedat Gashi Announces Record Fund-Raising Results for 2nd Quarter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gashi for Congress
body:
**Vedat Gashi Announces Record Fund-Raising Results for 2nd Quarter**
**Over $300,000 Achieved, Reflecting Campaign 's Accelerating Momentum**

Westchester County Legislator Vedat Gashi has announced his Democratic primary campaign for congress in NY 16 has raised over $300,000 in the second fundraising quarter of 2022. The campaign received hundreds of donations during the second quarter, reflecting accelerating momentum and increased support from voters across the district. These results are part of the over $800,000 raised by Gashi's campaign since the first quarter of this year.

"These donations during the latest quarter will enable our campaign to continue its progress towards primary day on August 23 with increased advertising, field operations and voter outreach," said Gashi, adding, "I offer many sincere thanks to those who contributed and those who are working on our campaign. This is a challenging primary race and we're working hard to accomplish much more on the campaign trail over the coming weeks".

"Our campaign is focused on delivering real progress for everyday New Yorkers and ensuring that everyone has a shot at the American dream, Gashi adds, noting that he will "fight to protect working families and expand the middle class, because this district deserves a representative who supports mainstream Democratic policies and values who will put progress before posturing and work hard to get things done".

New York's 16th congressional district for the United States House of Representatives includes part of the northern Bronx and the southern half of Westchester County, including the cities of Mount Vernon, New Rochelle, Rye, White Plains and Yonkers.

Westchester and Bronx residents interested in Gashi's campaign can visit [https://www.vedatgashi.com/](https://act.myngp.com/el/bYZCN8xkVnlbbh7Ka-bnrHiomNNkwSD5zE8_qXG7xQU=/HsI4Le9eiwm1aJb2GLzKFfujapDS9N_Qsl_zqkQSBuc=), [https://www.facebook.com/GashiforCongress](https://act.myngp.com/el/bYZCN8xkVnlbbh7Ka-bnrHiomNNkwSD5zE8_qXG7xQU=/BqRjMskFyPwdRyb68mp6wTqg-aV7U2ZJiCa9gvfOBbU=), [https://www.instagram.com/vedatgashi/](https://act.myngp.com/el/bYZCN8xkVnlbbh7Ka-bnrHiomNNkwSD5zE8_qXG7xQU=/bLLt_PAzmyAvPbtth9jzb59RfxsjN9R7rh-EXRnDYLU=) and [https://twitter.com/legislatorgashi](https://act.myngp.com/el/bYZCN8xkVnlbbh7Ka-bnrHiomNNkwSD5zE8_qXG7xQU=/JkJMbkEZCHa3GJoIEvV5z6cUuOHy9OSQKhPonPYR0GA=) to learn more, volunteer, and contribute.

Hello,
My team just wrapped up an emergency fundraising meeting. Chuck Grassley has already started smearing me across the entire state with attack ads, and Mitch McConnell is raising millions more to stop me from turning Iowa blue.
But with less than 24 hours until our critical mid-July fundraising deadline, we just checked ActBlue – and our grassroots fundraising has slowed way down. **If I’m going to send Chuck Grassley packing and protect our Democratic Senate majority, I’m counting on a new surge of donations from people like you now.**
The polling shows Grassley has never been more vulnerable, and we’re gaining ground. But Iowa was one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2020, and it’ll be even closer this year. Friend —

Derek,
I’ve done the math on this thing every which way, and the answer is always the same:
Democrats don’t hold the Senate majority (let alone expand it) in November without Ohio.
In a crummy Midterm year for Democrats, there just aren’t a lot of pickup opportunities, with one whopper of an exception.
Ohio—this race is so close that the Senate majority might as well be decided with a coin flip, and that means we’ve got a chance.
But we need your help to do that, Derek — can you split a donation between Tim Ryan’s campaign and CommonGood ASAP? He’s our best shot at expanding our Democratic Senate majority. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220715_CGVA_Ryan]

Republicans are talking as if they’ve already got Ohio in the bag. But if that’s true, why the hell are they pouring more than $80 million into trying to buy this open Senate seat?
It’s because they know that Tim Ryan can win.
That’s why they’re propping up their Silicon Valley puppet JD Vance with beaucoup bucks—because Tim Ryan would give working folks another voice in the Senate.
Tim Ryan is Democrats’ best chance at expanding the Senate majority and actually getting some legislation passed. Can I count on you to get off the sidelines and chip in to his campaign to flip Ohio blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_tr?refcode=20220715_CGVA_Ryan]
Mark my words: Ohio is THE battleground that will decide the Senate this year.
So let’s get to it.
James Carville

Friend: It's important for me to share my story with you about why I'm running and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read.
**Back when I was a social worker, I met a young boy who was being seriously neglected at home.** He needed immediate support – but I was told it would be weeks before he could be evaluated. I didn't think he would make it until then, so I went around the red tape and got him the help he needed. I was reprimanded, but that's what it took to save his life.

I remember being so angry that the system designed to help children like him had totally failed him. **That's when I heard that the Orlando Police Department was recruiting, and I took a call to protect and serve my community, to help people like that young boy.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47864865/355963014/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3746-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjcyMzJjYi00ZTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RajH2GiKKxv5A3QknBzgp2nWjoiJCputvbyN7rkoqnc=)
Fast-forward 27 years: I was Orlando's first woman chief of police and worked tirelessly so children like that young boy I'd met as a social worker didn't have to live in fear of playing in the streets. In my last days as chief, Mayor Buddy Dyer sat me down for a chat:
**"You have to run for Congress," he told me.**

Me? A politician? I never thought of myself that way. I even laughed.
But, as I let the idea sink in, I thought about that young boy I helped as a social worker – we were still in touch three decades later. I knew he wasn’t the only one who had to overcome hardship in his childhood: 1 in 7 kids in the U.S. lives in poverty. If I could do something to help kids like him, wouldn’t it be wrong to pass up the opportunity?

That’s when I realized that I needed to run for office to help as many children and working families as I could – so that in the next generation, more children from Florida could grow up with an incredible story of opportunity like mine. Ever since then, I’ve never stopped fighting toward that goal.
**[I'll never tire of an opportunity to do good and to serve the most vulnerable members of my community, and I'm asking you to do the same. Pitch in a contribution of $5 or more now to help send me to the Senate and continue my work of building a better future for our children.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47864866/355963042/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3746-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjcyMzJjYi00ZTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RajH2GiKKxv5A3QknBzgp2nWjoiJCputvbyN7rkoqnc=)**
Not a day goes by that I don't think about that child – or all of the working families who are counting on leaders like me to help them get through dark times. To thrive and not just survive.
**For me, that's what this is all about – and it's why I believe the Senate is where I can do the most good. If I win this race, Democrats can expand our Senate majority. We'll be able to extend the enhanced Child Tax Credit that's cut child poverty by more than 40%. We'll protect children from gun violence. And we'll help families keep food on the table by making groceries and gas more affordable.**
[**That's the long and short of why I'm in this race, friend. If you're ready to help me build a better future, will you donate to my campaign today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47864867/355963043/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3746-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjcyMzJjYi00ZTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RajH2GiKKxv5A3QknBzgp2nWjoiJCputvbyN7rkoqnc=)

Thanks for reading my story,

Val Demings

clean_body: help send me to the Senate and continue my work of building a better future for our children | | | Friend: It's important for me to share my story with you about why I'm running and why this campaign means so much to me. I hope you'll give it a read. Back when I was a social worker, I met a young boy who was being seriously neglected at home. He needed immediate support – but I was told it would be weeks before he could be evaluated. I didn't think he would make it until then, so I went around the red tape and got him the help he needed. I was reprimanded, but that's what it took to save his life. I remember being so angry that the system designed to help children like him had totally failed him. That's when I heard that the Orlando Police Department was recruiting, and I took a call to protect and serve my community, to help people like that young boy. = Fast-forward 27 years: I was Orlando's first woman chief of police and worked tirelessly so children like that young boy I'd met as a social worker didn't have to live in fear of playing in the streets. In my last days as chief, Mayor Buddy Dyer sat me down for a chat: "You have to run for Congress," he told me. Me? A politician? I never thought of myself that way. I even laughed. But, as I let the idea sink in, I thought about that young boy I helped as a social worker – we were still in touch three decades later. I knew he wasn’t the only one who had to overcome hardship in his childhood: 1 in 7 kids in the U.S. lives in poverty. If I could do something to help kids like him, wouldn’t it be wrong to pass up the opportunity? That’s when I realized that I needed to run for office to help as many children and working families as I could – so that in the next generation, more children from Florida could grow up with an incredible story of opportunity like mine. Ever since then, I’ve never stopped fighting toward that goal. = Not a day goes by that I don't think about that child – or all of the working families who are counting on leaders like me to help them get through dark times. To thrive and not just survive. For me, that's what this is all about – and it's why I believe the Senate is where I can do the most good. If I win this race, Democrats can expand our Senate majority. We'll be able to extend the enhanced Child Tax Credit that's cut child poverty by more than 40%. body:
I want to see Black communities that are patriotic, entrepreneurial, and spiritual. This is NOT what the mainstream media and BL
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zq7f68v81d7neateqr9tdoctp1uo7nu8iuofq2gg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkorr7djl69pn8cbkmdqj6drh6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8c74chie3cpke9p66c72chq36db3mupm2cr4meprac30cgoncoj5m6rj9ob4csrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor5ddkc1rm2pjlcaqr2ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdimeo74sjgmeoj24no)
[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zd600mscfbl2mplnn2qdfj7r8njv43a588j8ooa8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

Friend,

I'm disgusted by the biased media narrative about Black people being victims of systemic racism in 2022. This is after we elected a Black president and despite all the evidence of successful Black individuals in mainstream culture.

So why is there a perpetual narrative of Black victimhood?

**Because it is through fear and manipulation the media and organizations like BLM control Black communities. By keeping Black communities as victims, it allows BLM and others to exploit and keep their power over them. **

I too once believed this narrative. But something deep down told me to rethink everything I've been told. It was my grandfather who broke their narrative in a powerful way.

Now before I tell you the story, I want to introduce you to the BLEXIT Foundation.

I co-founded BLEXIT in 2019 in order to break the victimhood mentality in Black and urban communities. I see our communities being exploited by fear and victimhood in order to get them dependent on the government, which in turn breaks up the family, and ultimately, perpetuates the cycle of poverty.

**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.**

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

[_**Please help me shatter the victimhood mentality by donating $250, $100, $35, or any amount towards the BLEXIT Foundation. Give today by clicking here.**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zduqr83lc6qb1br5egaheq10rmgs6vn15clo5ptg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

**Story: How my grandfather taught me to never be a victim.**

My grandfather raised me. I didn't come from a perfect home. My parents split up. And what I enjoyed most about my grandfather were his stories.

He grew up during the Jim Crow era and real racism, not this fake racism CNN finds on the internet or lies about.

But there's one story he told I will NEVER forget.

As a boy, he worked on the family's share crop farm. Each morning he would wake up at 4am to lay out the tobacco to dry. Despite their difficult circumstances, they stayed together as a family and persevered.

**Then one night the KKK showed up. My grandfather woke up to bullets being shot into his home. He and his siblings hid underneath their beds.**

And then a smirk came across my grandfather's face "my father got his shotgun and fired back at them boys!"

The way he said it was with so much pride. And what I can't fathom is how in the face of this real danger, my grandfather was proud of his father for fighting back and not giving up.

Can you imagine if we all had this type of attitude?! Not letting circumstances hold us back. Not being a perpetual victim. Nowadays, people need days off work because a comedian told a joke that they don't like!

It was through my grandfather's example that I learned not to ever be a victim.

He eventually bought the same share crop farm his father worked on and started his own farm. He was financially successful, loved his wife, children, and grandchildren for his entire life.

While not everyone can have an individual like my grandfather in their lives, through BLEXIT we are going into Black and urban communities to empower people.

And it's working... _Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 15,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

[_**Friend, I am personally inviting you to support BLEXIT and spread our message of faith, freedom, and family to Black and urban communities. I am looking to raise $30,000 in the next 48 hours to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $1,000, $250, $100, $35, or $10 >>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z116l80l10c5v8tpoorkdob6n9q0eqt677qrtkqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z05qn7j27taggb8bomsnn6bg9uomugojek6r3hj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpr0f2km0ng4fpd200v3i2qvphf9hei3m5t177k0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z6lutfu76ahv22q5mvu3vn2qe0mv6t72ol6dsqk0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zqflmnt8vvcm2nkavcu8983786e89gi15r5i1hgg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zum6b9041f155fcboumra0ocq1q2ege0ug4u4k50_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zc9m2fs0380919sncp3ebnpj53ij4eu0mv3e87fg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zkmjgn28jtal6p6o2orpgrqdpv60gj4vs3urduqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z8o35eqqnsfc4qcf5pmpe6lr24s9gkl7p59ioc58_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z44nlugnnq9vu98qvla29m7jacdri8k5aaf8920o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

**Here 's how BLEXIT is making a difference:**

BLEXIT enters neighborhoods no one is bothering to help - Detroit, Baltimore, Houston, New Orleans, and many other cities. We are a "do tank", not a think tank. We're providing leadership, education, training, events, and activism to break the grip of victimhood mentality.

I want to see Black communities that are patriotic, entrepreneurial, and spiritual. This is NOT what the mainstream media and BLM want to see.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zb8pm0m038tu88uqu1g7q5875k21ugfq2sojuud0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlkrrdbir4cdmmn9ei5atdd3l64bu5dlcv1pga3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zckdd15rnqec44q5jhcf7c6scas74ps5ej0v90u8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

* **Teaching History:** Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5q7s23ge517tqljtb2loid4hf5215qv4qu0245o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message:** We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zlb5e7d3pusgg1ii6hvmv9som0nt9dtoqksvhi2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3ie9ob7c9h2bs)

The biggest enemy to the media's and BLM's narrative is an intact family. That's why everything we promote comes down to being pro-family, pro-freedom, and pro-faith.

I believe we're going to change society in a fundamental way. Either BLM and the victimhood mentality wins and we all become slaves to the government or we shatter their narrative and bring about a culture of freedom.

Thank you,

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

name: Reagan Dunn
subject: Malicious smears and outright lies
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Reagan Dunn for Congress
body:
I was prepared for the lies, false attacks, and malicious attempts to smear my character from the far left. I wasn't expecting was outright lies and falsehoods from fellow Republican candidates who, in their desperation to win, would resort to inventing lies out of thin air and spending hundreds of thousands of dollars to mislead voters. | | [](http://email.sermodigital.com/ct/60476557:sV1k9ChNb:m:1:2574580452:4BC641CAAB45A4744CF182EA7484DD0D:r "Reagan Dunn for Congress")
---
|
Dear ,

I'm writing to you today because of an extremely troubling development in our race for the 8th Congressional District.

When I got into this race, I was prepared for the lies, false attacks, and malicious attempts to smear my character from the far left. What I wasn't expecting was outright lies and falsehoods from fellow Republican candidates who, in their desperation to win, would resort to inventing lies out of thin air and spending hundreds of thousands of dollars to mislead voters.

Unfortunately, candidate Jesse Jensen has done exactly that. He's spending an enormous amount of money lying about my record. I want to set the record straight and ask for your help spreading the word: **Jesse Jensen is lying to voters.**

Let's set the record straight. I'm the only candidate in this race who:
* Is endorsed by the _King County Police Officers Guild_ , _the Washington Council of Police and Sheriffs_ , _former King County Sheriff and Congressman Dave Reichert_ , and _Kittitas County Sheriff Clay Myers_ because I've fought - successfully - to **increase** police funding over the course of my time in the King County Council.
* Signed a pledge to not raise taxes in Congress.
* Increased law enforcement funding in our community and fought the far-left's attempts to defund our police.

I'm a fiscal conservative and have the record to prove it - unlike Jensen, who called Socialist Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez a "fantastic role model" and supports programs that would raise income and payroll taxes for government-run healthcare.

At the end of the day, politics is a full-contact sport, and I'm not bothered by attacks. What bothers me is the openly cynical lies that Jensen is peddling in the hopes of hoodwinking voters. I need your help to set the record straight and combat these deceitful attacks.**Can you forward this email to five friends who live in the 8th Congressional District?
**
Your support is critical to our campaign, and I'm grateful to be running for Congress in such a great state.

Best,

Reagan Dunn

##
15 July 22

**THIS Tuesday, July 19 is the Primary Election Day!**

We've been working relentlessly! Over 7000 homes have been visited. Hundreds of thousands of texts have been sent to approximately 20,000 Republican Primary voters and over 5000 thousand calls have been made to these voters as well. We are working hard to earn the votes needed to help restore our Nation.

In these last days leading to the July 19th Primary, we are asking for All Hands On Deck!
We need YOU to help:
* leave Jeff Warner's pre-recorded message to voters through our online phone system
* pray

We're asking you to take 1-2 hours over the weekend to simply use our online system to leave a pre-recorded message from Jeff. You don't need to talk to the voter unless you want to.
Most of these opportunities do not take a lot of time, yet they will have a huge impact!
Contact the campaign for more details at Info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

**Social Media**
The campaign is taking steps to build Jeff Warner's social media presence.
You can find Jeff under RepJeffWarner on Facebook (https://www.facebook.com/RepJeffWarner) & Twitter (@RepJeff Warner).
Be sure to like, share, subscribe, follow, etc. to help us grow his following.

Thank You for your support. The campaign continues to make and break records. Come and be a part of this amazing team. Imagine how good it will be to say you were part of this team in November as we celebrate our historic victory!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=e6ad6aebbe&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

body:
| Dan is now running in the “median” congressional district in America. What does that mean, exactly?

It means that Michigan’s Eighth Congressional District is at the center of America’s politics. Exactly half of the country’s districts are more Democratic, and half are more Republican. It’s a true toss-up seat. And with 435 congressional seats, it sits exactly in the middle—the 218th seat—that will determine control of Congress.

In mid-Michigan, people rightfully don’t think about politics every day. Working families are worried about putting food on the table, paying rent and raising their families. They reject partisan politics and don’t care which party you’re affiliated with—they just want their elected officials to work on issues to make their lives better.

That’s the leadership that Dan Kildee brings to Congress. He’s focused every day on lowering the cost of gas, groceries and prescription drugs. He’s worked with Republicans and Democrats to protect the Great Lakes and support fair trade deals that boost Michigan’s manufacturing.

But as the Cook Political Report just put it, **_“Kildee could be in for the race of his life.”_** That’s because this new, middle-of-the-road district is a true toss-up, and could go either way.

Here in mid-Michigan, we’re now at the center of it all. **[So if you support Dan and his commonsense and pro-worker approach, can you chip in any amount to help support his campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47872460/355995701/-1174604059?amount=15&contactdata=FDPEZPPJipWiI8aAC2Y3Qp0GXijgYxZ1d3jMLYxJfJR1B0Dh1dUxGGQHp8vizgDwEeTqmuMVlah%2Bxmu640su0g3CAV%2BuG7BMVW%2B4CvtwDfuPUe%2BJQbghLMkG1ZeYikZjKISjKYyOhFqSpM%2B6DP%2Fqng%3D%3D&refcode2=64e09bfd-5f04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&refcode=DK_EM_FR_3MO_20220715_1_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGUwOWJmZC01ZjA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8YRRzEfY8j7WrehVQxI7smFHGgKBWhJS8VotZvpoCww=)**

clean_body: | Friend, Republicans have the momentum to retake the Senate in 2022, but Democrats are spending millions to try and stop us. That means we have to make sure we keep all of our Republican seats. If we lose even one, it could throw off our entire mission. That’s why I’m standing with conservative Ted Budd, and I’m proud to endorse Ted Budd for Senate. | Let me tell you a little bit about Ted: Ted Budd is a dedicated husband and father, and small businessman. He learned the values of hard work, family, and faith growing up on his family’s farm. It’s the same farm he’s raising his kids on today. Budd believes that we live in the greatest nation in the world, and we must protect our hard-working families from the liberal agenda. And quite frankly...I agree with him. He is exactly who we need in the Senate to stand up for conservative values to ensure that future generations have the same opportunities you and I have been blessed with. You can be sure he’ll defend our freedoms in Washington. I believe every single vote matters...and I also know every single dollar matters. Your financial support today will play an important role in helping Ted Budd win the Senate seat and keep North Carolina in Republican hands. Every dollar is key in funding get-out-the-vote efforts, ad buys, and everything else needed to get Ted Budd’s message out to voters. I know he’ll work to protect conservative values every day he serves in the Senate. Thank you for your support. My very best, Nikki R. Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi4tpqq4artnbo95gti4shbl6681dhltd96ffppo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg66oj2chh2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zc1p9pcbb7c025s2nde30lefsfgvq7h14gjcrv78_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg66oj2chh2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe

body:
Gov. Mike Parson signed a record $47 billion state operating budget for the 2023 fiscal year into law on June 30 after issuing 32 line-item vetoes | | | |
---
| | |
# Capitol Report
July 15, 2022
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| **Contact Senator Roberts** 201 W. Capitol Ave., Rm 329
Jefferson City, MO 65101
(573) 751-4415
Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov
---
| | | | | | [](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=4306ba735d&e=a088917f89)
---
| | [](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=176c154120&e=a088917f89)
---
| | [](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=b85853e1df&e=a088917f89)
---
|
---
| **PARSON SIGNS $47 BILLION STATE BUDGET BUT TRIMS $644 MILLION**
Gov. Mike Parson signed a record $47 billion state operating budget for the 2023 fiscal year into law on June 30 after issuing 32 line-item vetoes cutting nearly $644 million in spending authority approved by lawmakers in May. The bulk of the cuts came from eliminating $500 million for an income tax rebate for some Missourians.

A proposal House Republicans hastily threw together in the final days of the 2022 legislative session on paper called for providing rebates of up to $500 for a single person, or $1,000 for a married couple filing jointly, on income taxes already paid for the 2021 tax year. In reality, no one would have received the full amount and low-income taxpayers would have gotten nothing.

Although Parson had publicly criticized the policy, in his formal veto message he said he rejected the spending line because while it set aside $500 million for the tax rebates in a special fund, it didn’t include a constitutionally required provision actually authorizing the money to be spent. Parson subsequently vetoed a separate bill, House Bill 2090, that would have established the statutory framework for the state process the rebates.

Including the veto for the tax rebates, 14 of Parson’s line-item vetoes were to a special bill allocating Missouri’s share of federal pandemic relief funds. Those vetoes accounted for all but about $18.51 million of the total spending authority Parson eliminated, with the other 18 vetoes scattered throughout seven of the 13 other appropriations bills that make up the regular state operating budget.

Parson also signed three other appropriations bills into law providing nearly $904 million in spending authority for various capital improvement needs. He issued no vetoes to those bills.

One big highlight from the FY 2023 budget, which took effect July 1, is that it fully funds the state’s expanded Medicaid program for the first time, ending years of resistance by majority Republicans. Under the federal Affordable Care Act, the federal government pays 90 percent of the cost for serving the expanded population.

The budget also includes an additional $214 million for the Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary Education to fully fund the state’s share of local public school districts’ student transportation costs for the first time in three decades and $27 million to increase minimum pay for public school teachers to $38,000 a year, up from the current $25,000 annually. Public colleges and universities also are getting strong funding bumps after years of mostly flat spending levels.
---
|
---
| **NEW LAW MAKES IT EASIER TO REMOVE RACIST DEED RESTRICTIONS**
Racist restrictive covenants will be easier to remove from property deeds under legislation Gov. Mike Parson signed into law June 30. Although restrictive covenants prohibiting Black residents and those of other races and ethnicities from buying or occupying properties have been unenforceable for decades, they still appear on countless deeds and have proven difficult to remove.

House Bill 1662 requires racist covenants to be removed whenever property is transferred and a new deed recorded. Owners also may record a certificate releasing a property from a prohibited covenant. In addition, HB 1662 bars the imposition of restrictive covenants prohibiting property owners from installing solar panels and limits the regulations local governments can impose on home-based businesses, among other provisions relating to property law.
---
|
---
| **GOVERNOR FLOATS SPECIAL SESSION ON TAX CUTS**
Gov. Mike Parson on July 1 said he intends to call a special legislative session to enact the “largest income tax cut in state history” but conceded the details and price tag of his proposal have yet to be determined and that he isn’t certain when the session will take place during a busy election season when lawmakers weren’t planning to be in the Capitol.

Twice in the last eight years Missouri lawmakers have enacted what were each touted at the time as the “largest tax cut in state history.” As a result, there had been no serious discussion this year of another major, permanent tax cut, although House Republicans did hatch a scheme late during the regular legislative session for a one-time tax rebate to be paid for using current budget surpluses. Parson ultimately vetoed that plan.

However, talk of a significant election-year tax cut suddenly materialized after a new Missouri law took effect in late June to criminalize abortion in nearly all circumstances – including those involving rape or incest – and raise fears that birth control access will be outlawed next. With Parson and other Republicans suddenly subject to intense criticism over the law, their resulting pivot to discussing tax cuts appears to be an attempt to change the subject ahead of the looming elections.

The broad strokes Parson did offer of his proposal included reducing the income tax rate, eliminating tax brackets and increasing the standard deduction so that earned income of up to $16,000 a year for an individual and $32,000 annually for a married couple is tax free. Parson also said the special session would include creating new tax breaks and extending existing ones for agricultural producers.

Although the tax rebate bill Parson vetoed would have imposed a one-time hit to the state treasury, his new plan calls for permanent tax cuts that could blow a hole in the state budget when the current revenue surpluses are gone or the economy weakens. Because the Missouri Constitution requires voter approval to impose significant tax increases, tax cuts that leave the state with insufficient revenue to pay for basic services aren’t easily undone.

Until the governor issues a proclamation formally calling a special session, there is no guarantee one will take place. But if it does, there are two probable timeframes for when it would happen – either late August through mid-September during the lull following the Aug. 2 primary or a lame-duck session after the Nov. 8 general election. Parson said he wants the tax cuts in place by the end of this year. The next regular legislative session begins Jan. 4.
