| **BILLS PROVIDING TAX BREAKS AMONG FOUR TO FALL TO VETOES**
Gov. Mike Parson vetoed four bills passed by the Republican-controlled General Assembly this year, striking measures that sought to authorize one-time income tax rebates to certain taxpayers, provide tax breaks for agricultural producers, regulate kratom products and impose new restrictions relating to bond issues for St. Charles County school districts.

In his official veto message, Parson said he rejected House Bill 2090 because it falsely promised taxpayers they would receive $500 for an individual or $1,000 for a married couple filing jointly. Parson said taxpayers who received a rebate would have gotten no more than $205 for an individual or $410 for a married couple, and most would have received less than that or nothing at all. Since the legislation originally was limited to changing how often state employees are paid, Parson also said the it violates constitutional provisions requiring bills to be limited to a single subject and prohibiting them from being changed from their original purpose.

The governor also vetoed House Bill 1720, which sought to extend several tax credit programs for agricultural producers. Parson objected to the fact that lawmakers set the programs to expire after just two years and advocated for a longer timetable before the tax breaks have to be renewed. In addition, Parson said a provision relating to recycled asphalt shingles wasn’t germane to the bill.

Parson’s other vetoes were to House Bill 1667, regulating kratom products, and Senate Bill 724, relating to county financial statements. Parson said the legislature’s attempt to regulate kratom, an herbal stimulant of questionable therapeutic value that can prove harmful at high doses, conflicts with federal regulations. He objected to SB 724 because of a provision imposing restrictions on how St. Charles County school districts manage bond issues. Parson said the provision violates the state constitution’s prohibition on “special laws” that apply only to certain jurisdictions and would have caused significant practical problems for constructing projects using bond proceeds

Lawmakers can attempt to override the governor’s vetoes at their annual veto session on Sept. 14. Veto overrides require the approval of two-thirds majorities in each legislative chamber. Lawmakers haven’t successfully overridden any of Parson’s vetoes during his four years as governor.

The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | PARSON SIGNS $47 BILLION STATE BUDGET BUT TRIMS $644 MILLION Gov. Mike Parson signed a record $47 billion state operating budget for the 2023 fiscal year into law on June 30 after issuing 32 line-item vetoes cutting nearly $644 million in spending authority approved by lawmakers in May. The bulk of the cuts came from eliminating $500 million for an income tax rebate for some Missourians. A proposal House Republicans hastily threw together in the final days of the 2022 legislative session on paper called for providing rebates of up to $500 for a single person, or $1,000 for a married couple filing jointly, on income taxes already paid for the 2021 tax year. In reality, no one would have received the full amount and low-income taxpayers would have gotten nothing. Although Parson had publicly criticized the policy, in his formal veto message he said he rejected the spending line because while it set aside $500 million for the tax rebates in a special fund, it didn’t include a constitutionally required provision actually authorizing the money to be spent. Parson subsequently vetoed a separate bill, House Bill 2090, that would have established the statutory framework for the state process the rebates. Including the veto for the tax rebates, 14 of Parson’s line-item vetoes were to a special bill allocating Missouri’s share of federal pandemic relief funds. Those vetoes accounted for all but about $18.51 million of the total spending authority Parson eliminated, with the other 18 vetoes scattered throughout seven of the 13 other appropriations bills that make up the regular state operating budget. Parson also signed three other appropriations bills into law providing nearly $904 million in spending authority for various capital improvement needs. He issued no vetoes to those bills. One big highlight from the FY 2023 budget, which took effect July 1, is that it fully funds the state’s expanded Medicaid program for the first time, ending years of resistance by majority Republicans. Under the federal Affordable Care Act, the federal government pays 90 percent of the cost for serving the expanded population. The budget also includes an additional $214 million for the Missouri Department of Elementary and Secondary Education to fully fund the state’s share of local public school districts’ student transportation costs for the first time in three decades and $27 million to increase minimum pay for public school teachers to $38,000 a year, up from the current $25,000 annually. Public colleges and universities also are getting strong funding bumps after years of mostly flat spending levels. | | NEW LAW MAKES IT EASIER TO REMOVE RACIST DEED RESTRICTIONS Racist restrictive covenants will be easier to remove from property deeds under legislation Gov. Mike Parson signed into law June 30. Although restrictive covenants prohibiting Black residents and those of other races and ethnicities from buying or occupying properties have been unenforceable for decades, they still appear on countless deeds and have proven difficult to remove. House Bill 1662 requires racist covenants to be removed whenever property is transferred and a new deed recorded. Owners also may record a certificate releasing a property from a prohibited covenant. In addition, HB 1662 bars the imposition of restrictive covenants prohibiting property owners from installing solar panels and limits the regulations local governments can impose on home-based businesses, among other provisions relating to property law. | | GOVERNOR FLOATS SPECIAL SESSION ON TAX CUTS Gov. Mike Parson on July 1 said he intends to call a special legislative session to enact the “largest income tax cut in state history” but conceded the details and price tag of his proposal have yet to be determined and that he isn’t certain when the session will take place during a busy election season when lawmakers weren’t planning to be in the Capitol. Twice in the last eight years Missouri lawmakers have enacted what were each touted at the time as the “largest tax cut in state history.” As a result, there had been no serious discussion this year of another major, permanent tax cut, although House Republicans did hatch a scheme late during the regular legislative session for a one-time tax rebate to be paid for using current budget surpluses. Parson ultimately vetoed that plan. However, talk of a significant election-year tax cut suddenly materialized after a new Missouri law took effect in late June to criminalize abortion in nearly all circumstances – including those involving rape or incest – and raise fears that birth control access will be outlawed next. With Parson and other Republicans suddenly subject to intense criticism over the law, their resulting pivot to discussing tax cuts appears to be an attempt to change the subject ahead of the looming elections. The broad strokes Parson did offer of his proposal included reducing the income tax rate, eliminating tax brackets and increasing the standard deduction so that earned income of up to $16,000 a year for an individual and $32,000 annually for a married couple is tax free. Parson also said the special session would include creating new tax breaks and extending existing ones for agricultural producers. Although the tax rebate bill Parson vetoed would have imposed a one-time hit to the state treasury, his new plan calls for permanent tax cuts that could blow a hole in the state budget when the current revenue surpluses are gone or the economy weakens. Because the Missouri Constitution requires voter approval to impose significant tax increases, tax cuts that leave the state with insufficient revenue to pay for basic services aren’t easily undone. Until the governor issues a proclamation formally calling a special session, there is no guarantee one will take place. But if it does, there are two probable timeframes for when it would happen – either late August through mid-September during the lull following the Aug. 2 primary or a lame-duck session after the Nov. 8 general election. In his official veto message, Parson said he rejected House Bill 2090 because it falsely promised taxpayers they would receive $500 for an individual or $1,000 for a married couple filing jointly. Parson said taxpayers who received a rebate would have gotten no more than $205 for an individual or $410 for a married couple, and most would have received less than that or nothing at all. Since the legislation originally was limited to changing how often state employees are paid, Parson also said the it violates constitutional provisions requiring bills to be limited to a single subject and prohibiting them from being changed from their original purpose. The governor also vetoed House Bill 1720, which sought to extend several tax credit programs for agricultural producers. Parson objected to the fact that lawmakers set the programs to expire after just two years and advocated for a longer timetable before the tax breaks have to be renewed. In addition, Parson said a provision relating to recycled asphalt shingles wasn’t germane to the bill. Parson’s other vetoes were to House Bill 1667, regulating kratom products, and Senate Bill 724, relating to county financial statements. Parson said the legislature’s attempt to regulate kratom, an herbal stimulant of questionable therapeutic value that can prove harmful at high doses, conflicts with federal regulations. He objected to SB 724 because of a provision imposing restrictions on how St. Charles County school districts manage bond issues. Parson said the provision violates the state constitution’s prohibition on “special laws” that apply only to certain jurisdictions and would have caused significant practical problems for constructing projects using bond proceeds Lawmakers can attempt to override the governor’s vetoes at their annual veto session on Sept. 14. Veto overrides require the approval of two-thirds majorities in each legislative chamber. body:
Friend, my story is one of community. It made me who I am today, and it's why I fight so hard for Nevada in the Senate.
| | |
---
The little girl in this photo has no clue what a wild ride life has in store for her. Right now, all she knows is the joy of weekend camping with her family, tearing into her mom’s homemade meatballs and begging her dad to buy her a dirt bike.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47877100/356012839/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1888-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWZkNjRhNS02ODA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=efxPATAWLdj8a_GBLz9Le6ty89b5uV3822a6_YHoglM=)
Her dad raised her on three principles: work hard, be honest and respect everyone. She spent her life watching him pour his heart into bettering his community, and she became a first-generation college graduate and pursued a career in law to protect that community.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47877101/356012840/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1888-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWZkNjRhNS02ODA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=efxPATAWLdj8a_GBLz9Le6ty89b5uV3822a6_YHoglM=)
She went on to be elected Nevada’s attorney general just as the 2008 financial crisis wreaked havoc on America’s middle-class families and our economy. She took on the Big Banks with a fellow attorney general from California and secured $1.9 billion in relief for Nevada homeowners.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47877102/356012841/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1888-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWZkNjRhNS02ODA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=efxPATAWLdj8a_GBLz9Le6ty89b5uV3822a6_YHoglM=)
In 2016, she would make history as the first woman from Nevada and first Latina ever elected to the United States Senate. The odds were stacked against her, and many said she had no chance of winning. Mitch McConnell and the GOP spent nearly $50 million to defeat her, but her grassroots team stood by her every step of the way.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47877103/356012842/-375078852?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1888-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWZkNjRhNS02ODA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=efxPATAWLdj8a_GBLz9Le6ty89b5uV3822a6_YHoglM=)
Friend, my story is one of community. It made me who I am today, and it's why I fight so hard for Nevada in the Senate. People doubted that a Latina could compete and overcome the odds to win. I’ve proven them wrong every time, and I know that with your help, I can do it again.
**But right now, Donald Trump’s handpicked candidate is leading me by 1 point in the polls, and FiveThirtyEight's Nate Silver says I’m in serious danger of losing this toss-up race. Protecting my Democratic seat in Nevada is _crucial_ for defending our Senate majority. That's why Mitch McConnell and his allies are spending $22 million to defeat me, and it's why I have to ask:**

_Moore v. Harper_ is the latest Republican power grab, and it may be their biggest yet. If they’re successful, it could be a disaster for our democracy. The case threatens our systems of checks and balances, and if the Republicans get what they want from the Court, _Moore v. Harper_ would give state legislatures, many of which are gerrymandered and don’t accurately reflect voters, near-total power over how federal elections are conducted. The basis for this case is the truly fringe and dangerous "independent state legislature" theory.

That means the days of judicial reviews and governors vetoing gerrymandered maps could be gone, in direct contravention of nearly a century of Supreme Court precedent.

It could also mean the end of voting protections as we know them since state courts have been one of the last defenses against voter suppression laws passed by Republican-controlled state legislatures.

clean_body: Republicans are aiming for a nationwide power grab. | | = Friend, The ultra-conservative majority on the U.S. Supreme Court has already shown its willingness to turn over the fate of basic constitutional rights to the whims of gerrymandered state legislatures. Next year, they could go even further in a case called Moore v. Harper. If you’re already familiar with Moore v. Harper, I’ll cut right to the chase -- our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, is supporting the right side in this case as it heads to the Supreme Court, and we need supporters like you to help us keep up the fight, both inside and outside of courtrooms. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Moore v. Harper is the latest Republican power grab, and it may be their biggest yet. If they’re successful, it could be a disaster for our democracy. The case threatens our systems of checks and balances, and if the Republicans get what they want from the Court, Moore v. Harper would give state legislatures, many of which are gerrymandered and don’t accurately reflect voters, near-total power over how federal elections are conducted. The basis for this case is the truly fringe and dangerous "independent state legislature" theory. That means the days of judicial reviews and governors vetoing gerrymandered maps could be gone, in direct contravention of nearly a century of Supreme Court precedent. It could also mean the end of voting protections as we know them since state courts have been one of the last defenses against voter suppression laws passed by Republican-controlled state legislatures. = Thank you, Eric H. body:
Just an American who loves his country enough to fight for it
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60809450:JK5Z5jV7N:m:1:3253819041:49A55C1AE9847281670A0BAA9AC93D9F:r) Peter, I'm just going to say it how it is: _I 'm nothing special._ This is Ryan Zinke. I could sit here and tell you how important my career was as a Navy SEAL or how privileged I am to have worked alongside President Trump in the Oval Office. But honestly, Peter, none of that is important. _**What really matters is that we are ALL Americans. **_ _**Even more than that, we are ALL Children of God. **_ But that's not how Democrats see it. They try their hardest to divide us into categories - separating the right from the left, the rich from the poor, and the black from the white. They want us divided, separated, deeply disconnected. And most of all, they want us to forget what this country was founded upon: **Life, Liberty and the Pursuit of Happiness. A little thing we call the American Dream - **_a promise that anyone, no matter who they are or where they came from, has the opportunity to advance and seek prosperity for themselves and their families._ Personally, I grew up a lot like you. My father was a plumber, and I was born in a trailer park for much of my early life. The American Dream was the only thing that kept me going, and is what eventually allowed me to pursue a football scholarship to go to college, earn a successful career in the Navy SEALs, and ultimately sit at President Trump's right hand as his Secretary of the Interior. But I'm not special. I'm not the only one who made something of themselves thanks to the freedoms America provides. So many others have the same story as me. _**But Democrats have made it their mission to destroy that promise, and I will no longer sit around and watch. **_ **So now, I 'm running for Congress in the single most important House race in the country and I need your help to get me across the finish line.** So far this year, I've had 3 crucial fundraising goals that I absolutely needed to reach, and I've come up shy. Every. Single. Time. My last and most important deadline is tonight. If I miss this, that'll be 4 in a row and I'll have nothing left in the bank to keep up the fight. I'll be forced to wipe my hands with this race and my far-left opponent will join Congress as Nancy Pelosi's newest footsoldier. [**So please, would you join me in protecting our nation and fighting off the attacks from the Left by giving just $7 today?**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60809451:JK5Z5jV7N:m:1:3253819041:49A55C1AE9847281670A0BAA9AC93D9F:r) [**CHIP IN TODAY**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60809451:JK5Z5jV7N:m:1:3253819041:49A55C1AE9847281670A0BAA9AC93D9F:r) As a former Navy SEAL, you have my word: [**help me win today and I WILL return the favor in Congress.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60809452:JK5Z5jV7N:m:1:3253819041:49A55C1AE9847281670A0BAA9AC93D9F:r) Thank you and God bless America, [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60809452:JK5Z5jV7N:m:1:3253819041:49A55C1AE9847281670A0BAA9AC93D9F:r)

body:

Friend,

For as long as I can remember, I've been a fighter...****
[****](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zl68v5k6vl1m2clqvbbalg33qj4s9h2p80alvhj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****
As a little girl, my family fled communist North Korea while the Korean War raged around us. My parents were determined that regardless of the struggles we had faced, I would get a chance to live the American Dream. | [********](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvb7voeo3s6r38do7o60svucnjmbv6ho6p6t42r8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****[I 'm an immigrant](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zshae2oob2hthgi06qeqmsmlu3i4af1bbq31snl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****
---
Getting to the U.S. was not easy, and once here, I still had to overcome countless obstacles, charting a path to where I am today: [**one of the first Korean-American members of Congress.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuddujbqpb7aci35gu96pmm1q9acd37gkhbufeio_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)**[****](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2za3b3k283bdfprourgn5euqnbi3rdpulk7uckavg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)**

[********](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqd2bmen83hsev0qgbv2si9gchpd00ml22h9kqo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****[I 'm a trailblazer](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5o1l5ke8lmmg2h08lu69bu6soa2rqbs7563g95g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****
---
My mother owned a humble clothing store in California yet was constantly crushed by overbearing tax regulations. I built a coalition of community members and was elected to the State Board of Equalization - the nation's only elected tax board - where I represented more than nine million California residents.
[********](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpqgk683ebhnhb66bgl7cf1bq29mk9qb7tur5hl0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****[I 'm an advocate](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znqeqtti7tbh6794t8okscgh8a0qgtnas80eomr0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****
---
Now I am a member of Congress. I listened to the voters, and together we defied every prediction and flipped our district from Democrat to Republican.
[********](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmead8u3usotmfi19epouqutmd2rdkavdolkrqtg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****[I 'm a fighter](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zimubdf7alu23bgld9q15kpsnttbv88gbiit5hsg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****
---
**Unsurprisingly, the radical left is after me. They are trying to unseat me in the MOST IMPORTANT election of the year..**
**I am a woman, a conservative, and an immigrant.** I have spent my whole life fighting, but now I need your help. Washington liberals know how much is at stake and will do anything to stop me.
[**Can you chip in any amount today to save my seat and let me keep fighting for you?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgaabv13h6p2egk4vrusd6ghi77c8r388p952mmg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)

[********](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1covfeakc2pjfq3ofj5ohktk7qthgf3mopfhc3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****[Join Michelle Steel TODAY](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z65gs3ckcur6r8ft8cgi4mqkqu3he11e6h9kt4pg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)****

God Bless America,
Michelle Steel (R-CA)

Michelle Steel here. My story is like many Americans, it's an immigrant story.

Growing up, I heard of the horrors of communism from my parents, who had fled North Korea. We didn't have much growing up, but I worked hard and learned English, making it my third language. My mom and dad encouraged me to dream of a better life - **and I did. I became an American.**

I've spent my whole life fighting for the American Dream, and I won't stop. But now, Friend, that dream is under attack. And if we don't keep up with the Democrats,****there 's no chance to win back the H****ouse Majority.****
****

****

**If we don 't act now, the American Dream may be lost forever.**** And I think you agree that America _is worth fighting for._****

The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z58u94u30jt2m3m4sdlm5egndki662a41rok2m7g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onh6lgj5clm61jj1dr0c2oj2tbmm5jm9oj2e1qj4t9lmgrr4stmmdgmatbiemq3eduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdimmqefdj1cpr6eddm6uobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5svaatfsbuis3enqjomf0c8hbrd7svqib3klpqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjv5423s0cu6cnptnnuc4n62pdrqt6mjv0vgimfg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zicau69u6e9quqpuatoa9knpu6kdah8bfbfde3pg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cjg69o71cph2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

I care about the future of our democracy. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47879152/356019510/823540626?refcode=ea.c377cbbf-6d04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.c377cbbf-6d04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzc3Y2JiZi02ZDA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0AYL4f9m6OATWHF7KHMATOLaSrJhfgqG8z2mSKVwnrM=&emci=908108e1-ae03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c377cbbf-6d04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=1049176)
Peter, our democracy is teetering. Today’s Republican Party has proven that they will put party over country at every opportunity. Partisan gerrymandering has given the GOP outsized power at every level of government. Now, the Supreme Court is set to hear a case that could allow state legislatures to decide the outcome of our presidential elections. **In states like ours, with GOP-controlled legislatures, that would be a disaster.** I believe that this democracy _must_ be saved, and the only thing that can save it is for each of us to do our part. Peter, I will _always_ respect the outcome of free and fair elections, and I’m working hard to protect North Carolinians’ right to vote so everyone can have their voices heard in our government. subject: the GOP attack on Roe is a two-step process
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VAN HOLLEN FOR SENATE
body:
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47881278/356027802/396464211?refcode=em-logo&refcode2=2cb75f42-7304-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=ADUrZYVWwxe7VFwL%2F%2FVkyfh6osEevaSsTnmicpVXudWXL0hgA%2FWvzMk3i9Ti1V9k&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2I3NWY0Mi03MzA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aqAoyLUNlwMixX3ibAPVIsHqLUM4IxIskTffaW4aNYk=)
Every day we witness more of the extreme lengths to which Republicans are prepared to go to prevent women from making their own reproductive health care choices. That includes efforts in Republican-controlled states to make it a crime for a woman to travel to other states to seek an abortion and to criminalize doctors who perform them.
This extremism is not confined to GOP-run state legislatures; it is also a clear and present danger in the U.S. Senate. Just yesterday, Senate Republicans blocked our effort to bring up a bill that I have co-sponsored to prevent states from criminalizing the efforts of women to travel to other states for abortion health services. It is bad enough that the Supreme Court gave states the green light to strip away rights to reproductive freedom within their own borders. Now Republicans are trying to expand their extremist reach to the rest of the country.
[**Let me be clear: we cannot and will not let them succeed. We need to work like hell to stop this extremist agenda in its tracks. Click here if you are with me.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47881279/356027803/-78205283?refcode=em220715rrpetition&refcode2=2cb75f42-7304-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=ADUrZYVWwxe7VFwL%2F%2FVkyfh6osEevaSsTnmicpVXudWXL0hgA%2FWvzMk3i9Ti1V9k&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2I3NWY0Mi03MzA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aqAoyLUNlwMixX3ibAPVIsHqLUM4IxIskTffaW4aNYk=&emci=1d1ac145-6d04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2cb75f42-7304-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)
**[Pledge Now to fight back!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47881280/356027804/-78205283?refcode=em220715rrpetition&refcode2=2cb75f42-7304-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=ADUrZYVWwxe7VFwL%2F%2FVkyfh6osEevaSsTnmicpVXudWXL0hgA%2FWvzMk3i9Ti1V9k&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2I3NWY0Mi03MzA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aqAoyLUNlwMixX3ibAPVIsHqLUM4IxIskTffaW4aNYk=&emci=1d1ac145-6d04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2cb75f42-7304-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2216363)**
As I have warned before, the Republicans' strategy is a Two-Step Process. First, knock down the constitutional protections of Roe v. Wade. Second, elect anti-choice senators and representatives to push for a federal law banning abortion everywhere across our country.
That's their ultimate goal — and they are not shy about it.
That's one of many reasons we must elect more pro-choice senators and members of Congress in November. It's also another reason why we need to elect at least two more Democrats to the Senate so we can end the super-majority filibuster rule and pass a national law protecting reproductive rights for every American.
As my friend John Lewis, whose memory we are honoring today, would say: “nothing can stop the power of a committed and determined people to make a difference”!

clean_body: = Every day we witness more of the extreme lengths to which Republicans are prepared to go to prevent women from making their own reproductive health care choices. That includes efforts in Republican-controlled states to make it a crime for a woman to travel to other states to seek an abortion and to criminalize doctors who perform them. This extremism is not confined to GOP-run state legislatures; it is also a clear and present danger in the U.S. Senate. Just yesterday, Senate Republicans blocked our effort to bring up a bill that I have co-sponsored to prevent states from criminalizing the efforts of women to travel to other states for abortion health services. It is bad enough that the Supreme Court gave states the green light to strip away rights to reproductive freedom within their own borders. Now Republicans are trying to expand their extremist reach to the rest of the country. As I have warned before, the Republicans' strategy is a Two-Step Process. First, knock down the constitutional protections of Roe v. Wade. Second, elect anti-choice senators and representatives to push for a federal law banning abortion everywhere across our country. That's their ultimate goal — and they are not shy about it. That's one of many reasons we must elect more pro-choice senators and members of Congress in November. It's also another reason why we need to elect at least two more Democrats to the Senate so we can end the super-majority filibuster rule and pass a national law protecting reproductive rights for every American. As my friend John Lewis, whose memory we are honoring today, would say: “nothing can stop the power of a committed and determined people to make a difference”! Peter,

As a federal prosecutor, my job was to help take down the bad guys.

I prosecuted white-collar criminals who defrauded seniors. I put away shady doctors who illegally sold opiates. I also helped shut down a smuggling operation that sent American-made microchips to China.

Truth be told, I loved my old job, and I’m still getting used to calling up supporters for endorsements and contributions. Because when I introduce myself as a former federal prosecutor, the question I typically get in response is:

**_“Am I in trouble?”_**

My answer is always the same:

**_“No, but we’re all in trouble if we don’t flip this seat and Ken Calvert goes back to Washington. Can you send in a donation today?”_**

Jokes aside, I’m running for Congress because I’ve seen the threats to our country change as America has become more divided due to hyper-partisanship and misinformation. It’s time we start agreeing on the basic facts again, but it will take thoughtful legislation to tackle this problem at its roots.

name: Andrew P. McIndoe
subject: Share your thoughts on American energy independence
body:
Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9486%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=445BPuYhGTfBkZ%2fHHlQD3A&sysid=1)
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38878%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wBa1SkdQ8YVb7TSFUq80RA&sysid=1)
---
Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38879%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=siMjvsj97IJV6rZ22P%2bZ1Q&sysid=1) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think--and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c38870%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hhJhw8brq%2fpk%2fFrMUQWVsQ&sysid=1)** Thank you so much for your time. I am truly grateful. Best, Andrew P. McIndoe
VP, Development
---
| | The Heritage Foundation 214 Massachusetts Avenue NE Washington D.C. 20002
---

Friends - I know my team has reached out about our deadline tonight and the ambitious goal we set, but I wanted to personally explain why this race and your support are so important.
Nonpartisan analysts have said this will be one of the most competitive and most expensive races in the entire country. That’s because Senate Republicans know they have no path to the majority without North Carolina.
Winning this race means we expand the majority. It means I can cast the decisive 51st vote on voting rights, abortion rights, climate action and more. This is the kind of progress McConnell and his allies are desperate to stop, and the strength of our grassroots campaign has them extremely worried.
The truth is Republican super PACs thought over $6 million on false attack ads could quickly take us down. But it didn’t work. We are fighting back hard, and poll after poll continues to show us in a statistical tie.
But we cannot let up. It’s tough, but we have to pick up our fundraising pace to make sure they cannot drown us out. I wish I didn’t have to ask, but I know that making the kind of progress our families deserve — building a future where each and every one of us can thrive — is worth it.

Friend, Six months ago, I swore an oath to protect and serve the people of Virginia –– and to defend freedom, peace, and justice across our Commonwealth. Stepping into the office for the first time, I felt an immense sense of duty. I was elected to carry out a job, and failure was not an option. But I’ll be honest –– the situation was bad on day one. **The criminal-first, victim-last mentality of the last administration left danger in our streets, wokeness in our schools, and injustice in our courts.** So our administration got right to work. _We started enforcing the law.__We eliminated policies that restricted our freedoms._ _We took action to restore common sense across our government._ **We put law-abiding citizens, victims, and police officers FIRST. ** I’m proud of our first six months –– but I want you to know this fight to secure Virginia’s future and defend law and order is far from over. _[**If you support this mission, will you pitch in $6 to fuel the next phase of the Great Virginia Comeback?**](http://links.safervirginiapac.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=e917de37cf4d4a65a61d223d4fce0356&_e=zdb6_EGzsZ5ueU_dt8jp0a7wIaMVJx0K04cfqNjCyj1Kz04kc748j-1aI8U8MdeepNCsKCvfBIGKdTSkjGki12heiDfnxOeDcuzTtS5vF0BQOGHN3PeSG7DzzXXx-jUnpTsgemuM3m1z2kQ2o7HfAsVCb_UlYvneO64tp6A4zG5Sg8vkg7-l8hMVGgLVmtFiOz3e2gmRAok0stSPh3wqI14mm_eCKMkNrpoMFbZFzWfG498wp-qej8m8mN0yu9n_uZneTiarHWYkbaMkbq5S6YL8EDrf4CkuEVcMYJ2SVsWE6jX5AZKphihD5JUAB8z7USU_WVhfK5sSpgMNWLcy_e0Nb0iIfIOjrZ33UpCuuqhMLdZmwg7Ft67RnBlq9AVUFOq3yeZehkP_HSEbpst9aZ2XERd5ox6sMaNzy7lWzNLpsnyFd7hB5yCXlTWLo3agRgakQpsVuVCVOcDl2vFzmg%3D%3D)_

| Last year, in _Brnovich v. DNC_ , I took on the Democrats’ attempts to interfere with Arizona’s laws safeguarding our elections from ballot harvesting. I went all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court to defeat their plan to intrude in our elections. But Biden wants a rematch.

The Department of Justice plans to [sue](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=543ad44391&e=6dcd2506d1) Arizona over [HB 2492](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=821fd0f5c7&e=6dcd2506d1), which requires proof of citizenship to vote in federal elections. I say, _bring it on_. I will stand up for the right to enact common-sense election integrity measures—not just in Arizona, but in all states.

However, I find it curious that the DOJ’s lawsuit comes at a time when thousands of illegal border crossings happen daily. Our legislature passed HB 2492 to guard against non-citizen voting by ensuring that only citizens cast ballots. I won’t assume anything, but I know someone running for the U.S. Senate in Arizona who would greatly benefit from the votes of non-citizens let in by a federal government that has all but surrendered our sovereignty to the cartels.

I’m a fighter, and I hate losing. My message to the President is this: back off, unless you want to lose again. The last time Biden came after the Great State of Arizona and our election laws, he lost so badly that Mark Kelly and Chuck Schumer tried to federalize our elections. They failed.

Since day one, I’ve stood firm in my defense of Arizona’s election integrity, long before it was a talking point for other candidates. No one has defended the ballot box against fraud and manipulation more than I have.

Coming to a scoreboard near you: Brnovich 2, Biden 0.

---

---
Hello,

Revisionists of America’s history would have you believe that our nation was founded on secular grounds and that “a great wall of separation between Church and State” has been our guiding principle since the beginning. They would have you believe that our founders wanted Christianity to be completely absent from all forms and institutions of government.

That simply isn’t true, and I can prove it. In my brand-new coffee-table style book, _America Is a Christian Nation_ , you can see how our country has moved from its reliance on God to its rejection of God. It’s a short read, and we’ve paired the written content with some gorgeous patriotic photos that you’re going to enjoy looking through.
---
| | [LEARN THE TRUTH](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zme7o2f38a65butquajih8dml26cl22vn1kdcrc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cji6aoj4clh2bs)
---
[](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zuepufpjk6591fftvssem00tbi44sku8hul9v6tg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cji6aoj4clh2bs)
---
In appreciation for any gift you are able to make to _Pathway to Victory_ today, we’d like to send you a copy of this book along with a DVD copy of my message, _America is a Christian Nation_. I think you’ll find it informative and engaging. You can receive your copy by making your donation here: [https://ptv.org/donate/july-2022-america-is-a-christian-nation-by-dr-robert-jeffress](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8th2k3sus9b03u1sn5ivcv8jfk2mrekj9ma3ar8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cji6aoj4clh2bs)

You may already be convinced that America was founded as a Christian nation and that we have strayed far from that foundation. The question in that case is, how do we get back? You’ll find the answer to that question as well at the end of _America Is a Christian Nation_.

As believers, we need to do all we can to both preserve America’s unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope you’ll stand with me in doing so.

Sincerely,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
Senior Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
---

subject: Have you felt the pinch of inflation?
body:

Inflation is on the rise in America. And there's no sign of it
slowing down. In February, consumer prices rose 7.9 percent-the
highest annual inflation rate increase since January 1982.
Economic historian John Steele Gordon discussed inflation in a
recent issue of Imprimis, Hillsdale College's digest of liberty.
And he noted that adding trillions more to the national debt is
not the solution. In fact, it will only make the problem worse.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW4fhxChNy

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
fellow American,

Inflation
is on the rise in America. And there's no sign of it slowing
down.

In
February, consumer prices rose 7.9 percent-the highest annual
inflation rate increase since January 1982.

Economic
historian John Steele Gordon discussed inflation in a recent
issue of Imprimis, Hillsdale College's digest of liberty. And he
noted that adding trillions more to the national debt is not the
solution. In fact, it will only make the problem worse.

Nevertheless, support for socialism and other ideologies
destructive of the free market also appears to be on the rise in
our country, especially among younger Americans.

That's
why you're receiving this email today.

Hillsdale
College seeks to understand more clearly what Americans think
about our nation's economy and the inflation we're experiencing.
And I'm hoping you can help by completing our National Survey on
Inflation in the United States using the secure link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/national-survey-on-inflation/

The
survey will take you only a few minutes to complete. But the
results will help us develop an effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about free market economics.

This
educational effort is critical to reining in the growing appetite
in Washington, D.C., to print more money to pay for
ever-expanding government programs.

We think
education is the surest way to reverse this dangerous trend. And
your partnership with Hillsdale College is vital as we expand our
efforts to defend liberty nationwide by reaching and teaching
millions.

So please
don't wait.

Share
your opinions on inflation and the state of our nation's economy
by completing the National Survey on Inflation in the United
States using this secure link:
https://lp.hillsdale.edu/national-survey-on-inflation/.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S.
Inflation in the United States is on the rise. We need your
opinions to develop an effective strategy to educate millions of
Americans about this growing threat to liberty.

Please
complete our National Survey on Inflation in the United States
using the secure link below:

body:
Hey friend,

I’m reaching out to update you on the work I’ve been doing recently. As you know, over the past three and a half years we’ve made great strides on several fronts, including service improvements in our branch offices and overseeing the safest, most secure elections in Michigan history. With that said, this is a busy and exciting time in Michigan and I want you to know what I’m doing to serve our state and earn re-election in November.
Here’s some exciting news to start off: We are less than a month away from our first statewide election since 2020, and already over one million Michigan registered voters have requested their absentee ballot! That is roughly double the number who had requested absentee ballots at this point in the 2018 campaign year. It’s clear to me that Michigan’s constitutional right to vote by absentee ballot - which was approved by voters in 2018 - continued to be a big boost for voter turnout and our democracy.

Local clerks are busy processing this historic increase in ballot requests, and I’m working hard to ensure that on Primary Day - August 2nd - we will continue our tradition of safe, secure, and transparent elections in Michigan. We did it before, friend, and this year we’re going to do it again.

Will you pitch in to support my re-election campaign today to help ensure that I can continue protecting our elections and our democracy for years to come? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071322]

The primary is almost upon us, which means Election Day is just around the corner! I’ve been spending time traveling across Michigan and meeting voters of all ages who are ready to defend our democracy in November. Some of the best democracy defenders are the ones I met at the Traverse City Cherry Festival who are still years away from being able to exercise their right to vote.

Meeting Michiganders from all walks of life is one of my favorite aspects of campaigning. And as always, the conversations I have invigorate me with a deep sense of optimism for the future of our democracy and our country.

These conversations are also important to reinforce the truth about the integrity of our election process and to fight back against the coordinated effort to undermine our democracy. Friend, will you make a contribution to my campaign today to help ensure that I can continue talking to voters and spreading our message across the state?

Donate>> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=071422]

Thank you for reading, and I hope to see you out on the campaign trail soon!

-Jocelyn

body:

---
| | | **Voter Protection and Ballot Access Interfaith Briefing with Chair Jamie Harrison and DNC Senior Staff**

Hi all, We are excited about our upcoming virtual Voter Protection and Ballot Access Briefing, and would love for you to be there! As a reminder the event will take place on****_**July 19th, 2022 from 12pm-1pm ET.**_ Featuring DNC Chair Jaime Harrison and our Voter Protection Team, this event will dive into the importance of protecting the vote in the 2022 election and beyond, and will have an emphasis on how the Interfaith community can be involved. **To RSVP, please use the link below.** If you have any questions, please reach out to the DNC’s Interfaith Advisor, Fred Davie, at [davief@dnc.org](mailto:davief@dnc.org). Thank you!
---
| [RSVP Here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=0e8da89dc6&e=d6c5c7d7ec "RSVP Here")
---
| _All guests attending or participating in this event must either be operating on the “coordinated side” of federal campaign finance law OR must not work for an organization that engages in electoral activity. If you or your organization are involved in or are making “independent expenditures,” “electioneering communications,” other paid public communications concerning elections or that trigger coordination issues under 11 C.F.R. 109.21(c) (or analogous state campaign finance coordination laws) this cycle, or are otherwise engaged in GOTV or voter registration activities that cannot be coordinated with federal party committees and candidates, you may not attend, unless you are personally separated from that work by a firewall within your organization that satisfies the requirements of 11 C.F.R. 109.21(h) (or are otherwise structuring your activities later in the cycle so that you can coordinate with candidates and party committees at this time). By attending, you agree that you comply with these requirements and also agree that you will not share any information you obtain through this event with any person or entity on the “independent side” or that is engaged in communications and activities that cannot be coordinated with the DNC. Please reach out to your own counsel if you have questions about these legal requirements prior to the meeting.*_

Peter, The RINO Establishment failed to stop me in the primary... so now they’re teaming up with the Far-Left Media to smear this campaign and smear my voters.
**They want you to think that Pennsylvania voters have turned on me... that you’re alone in supporting me** ... that there’s something wrong or evil about having conservative values.
It couldn’t be further from the truth, Peter. It’s just smoke and mirrors.

There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. | | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Peter Willis, did you get a chance to read Derek's email yesterday?

Derek is determined to continue batting for our region in Congress. With the August 2 primary election only weeks away, we're running out of time to reach voters.

This campaign isn't just about fighting for our community. It's also about fighting for folks all across the country by using the power of the ballot to protect leaders who are going to bat for our values.

**[If you haven't already, will you contribute whatever you can to help Derek reach our mid-month goal? Every dollar we raise before midnight tonight will help us reach voters before the primary.](https://act.myngp.com/el/83Xvz193Vm7S0Yy8LPAwUmXUxt4McMOedwNmc5HZxAc=/o8TxcqHi5S0DAI4aBGd5QYUJ-VKNlYMot8J2vAAL8qo=?refcode=em22_220714_mm2kic_fndd_gq_act___TK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220714_mm2kic_fndd_gq_act___TK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})**

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Derek Kilmer
Date: Thursday, July 14, 2022
Subject: This is our last mid-month deadline until the primary, Peter.

Hi Peter - I'll be brief:

Tomorrow is our last mid-month deadline before the primary, which means it's time to kick our campaign into high gear!

On our team, we say this: "Don't agonize. Organize!" With so much at stake in the midterm elections, we need all hands on deck to build a winning campaign. I'm counting on YOUR support to help us keep up the momentum.

It's up to us to make sure that our crucial - but narrow - blue majority is protected in Congress. And with so much on the ballot this year, from reproductive rights to Social Security and Medicare, we can't afford to stay on the sidelines this election.

[**We 're talking to every voter we can reach to make sure they know what's at stake in this election. That's why we've set a $15,000 mid-month goal - and we need your help to hit it. body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Facebook%20Cover.png]
Hi Peter,
Over the course of the campaign so far, I've had the opportunity to talk with so many people across this newly drawn Fifth Congressional District. Once we get past the noisy and divisive rhetoric, we find that we're all dealing with the same issues. The other candidates in this race seem to be more focused on the approval of their party bosses than on addressing the needs of Tennesseans though. Across the country we're seeing extremist right-wing candidates winning in race after race.
My grandparents were Republicans and if they were alive today they wouldn't recognize their party. They were proponents of fiscal stability, civility, and hard work, and they thought that the government should stay out of people's bedrooms. That makes sense to me, as we're facing alarming challenges to our personal rights on so many fronts. As I said in a Tennessean op-ed a few months ago:
"We now find ourselves in a world where an obnoxious minority demands that we exercise identity politics to kill identity politics, that we adopt extreme government overreach to prevent government overreach, and that we employ prejudice to eradicate prejudice."
As a mom, a small-town mayor, and a state senator, I've had the opportunity to lean about Middle Tennessee issues from several vantage points. Through my service on the Greater Nashville Regional Council and the Mayor's Caucus, I gained a comprehensive understanding of the challenges this district will be facing in the coming years.
I am running for Congress because I want to be a voice for the people I've been representing for over a decade on the municipal level and in the state legislature, and a voice for the amazing communities included in this newly drawn district, in the federal government.
We are going to win this campaign, but I need your help to do it. Please consider clicking here to chip in and help us win! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellacq]
Heidi Campbell

As a mom, a small-town mayor, and a state senator, I've had the opportunity to lean about Middle Tennessee issues from several vantage points. Through my service on the Greater Nashville Regional Council and the Mayor's Caucus, I gained a comprehensive understanding of the challenges this district will be facing in the coming years. I am running for Congress because I want to be a voice for the people I've been representing for over a decade on the municipal level and in the state legislature, and a voice for the amazing communities included in this newly drawn district, in the federal government. We are going to win this campaign, but I need your help to do it. Please consider clicking here to chip in and help us win! **\- Candidate Spotlight: Destiny Wells, Candidate for Secretary of State - ** _Each week, the Indiana Democratic Party will shine a light on one of its statewide candidates for the upcoming fall elections. _ Destiny Wells grew up in a farming family in Morgan County. She attended Indiana University at Bloomington and after the 9/11 attack on our country, decided to enlist in the Army National Guard. Almost 19 years later, she is now a U.S. Army Reserve Lieutenant Colonel. During this time, she also became a lawyer and started a business. As an attorney, she served as Deputy Attorney General for the State of Indiana. In the service, she met her husband, Oliver, a military intelligence Lieutenant Colonel in the Indiana Army National Guard and together they are raising two sons, Owen and Harrison. Now she’s running to fight for families across the Hoosier state as our next Secretary of State. Democracy is on the ballot and as our next Secretary of State, Destiny is ready to put a stop to the Indiana GOP’s corruption and deliver a future that maintains election integrity, spends state tax dollars responsibly, protects individual freedoms, and secures a person’s American right to vote at the ballot box. subject: Snooki has a message to cheer Dr. Oz up
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
“Heyyyy Mehmet” -Snooki
#
Look Derek, it must be hard for Dr. Oz, trying to live and campaign in a completely new place (Pennsylvania).
So we put together a very, very special video with the one and only Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi from MTV’s _Jersey Shore_ to cheer him up. 👇
Honestly, the first paragraph sums it up:
> [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-1?refcode=em20220715-6533&refcode2=6533_434096_XTu3Gk&akid=6533%2E434096%2EXTu3Gk)
>
> “Heyyyy Mehmet...this is Nicole “Snooki”, and I’m from Jersey Shore...
> I heard that you moved from New Jersey to Pennsylvania to look for a new job...
> I know you’re away from home and you’re in a new place, but Jersey will not forget you... And don't worry, because you’ll be back home in Jersey soon. **This is only temporary.”**

**[Watch Snooki’s message to Dr. Oz. Then, if you want to help us send our dude Dr. Oz home to Jersey, chip in $5 or any amount now to our grassroots campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220715-6533&refcode2=6533_434096_XTu3Gk&akid=6533%2E434096%2EXTu3Gk)**
We really hope Dr. Oz enjoyed this message from a fellow iconic Garden State celebrity. It’s good to see two New Jerseyans sticking together. 😌
There are a lot of bad things about Dr. Oz. He’s a fraudster who made a fortune by lying to people on TV. He’s a self-funded multi-millionaire. He said he supports an extreme ban on abortions with no exceptions for rape or incest.
And like Snooki said... **DUDE IS NOT EVEN FROM HERE!!!**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-1?refcode=em20220715-6533&refcode2=6533_434096_XTu3Gk&akid=6533%2E434096%2EXTu3Gk)
**We have our fun, but we’re also working *really* hard to win this thing, Derek, because the stakes couldn’t be any higher Pennsylvania.**
**[If you’re with us, can you chip in $5 contribution (or more if you can swing it) to help? This race is going to be incredibly expensive, and we need to keep up with Oz’s spending.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220715-6533&refcode2=6533_434096_XTu3Gk&akid=6533%2E434096%2EXTu3Gk)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220715-6533&refcode2=6533_434096_XTu3Gk&akid=6533%2E434096%2EXTu3Gk)**
Dr. Oz, if you’re reading this, we hope you loved your video. We bet you miss home, but you’ll be there soon. We’re going to make sure of that!
— Team Fetterman
P.S. If any of yinz are wondering, this cameo from the one + only Snooki cost $393.75. The results? Priceless. But also feel free to [**chip in a few bucks**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-1?refcode=em20220715-6533&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6533_434096_XTu3Gk&akid=6533%2E434096%2EXTu3Gk) to cover the cost, lol.

And put aside the fact that the media, Hollywood, and the Democrats are working overtime to take your guns away (that I expect)...

These red flag laws allow judges to block American citizens from owning guns if someone testifies of a _potential_ public danger.

_“Potential_ danger.”

So for example...

The Democrats could simply bring _any_ Republican to a judge and argue that he’s an insurrectionist white supremacist domestic terrorist **and should have his firearms taken away immediately...**

And considering Joe Biden is appointing as many left-wing activist judges as he can...

...all of whom will gladly find **any** reason to call you a white-supremacist domestic terrorist...

That’s why these “Red Flag” laws are so scary and why I’m against them.

Meanwhile though...

13 Republican senators went along with it.

Not good. Not good at all.

Now you have my word: I will NEVER support Red Flag laws that threaten your constitutional right to bear arms.

And I will NEVER join forces with the Democrats to take your firearms away.

Sincerely,

Mark.

name: Charles Booker
subject: Yesterday’s birthday party
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, yesterday
we celebrated my mom’s birthday.

Her sacrifice is why I’m here. When I was growing up, after doing my
homework, mom would call me down for dinner. Sometimes, she’d give me my
plate and leave the kitchen. I noticed she wasn’t eating, and asked her
why.

After avoiding my question, she admitted she wasn’t eating to save food
for me.

Mom, thank you. Thank you for your strength, your love, your grace, and
your sacrifice. Thank you for being the best mom I could ever ask for. I
am proud of you, and honored to celebrate you with the world.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220715.uuxJj2&refcode=em20220715-2226&t=1001&akid=2226%2E346206%2E-7iQaq ][IMG]

I know my story isn’t unique: there are thousands of mothers in Kentucky
who are making painful sacrifices, working multiple jobs, and still can’t
make ends meet. That’s why I believe it’s time to write a new kind of
politics that works for families, not corporations. We need to replace
Rand Paul with a leader who understands the pain working families in our
country face.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220715.uuxJj2&refcode=em20220715-2226&t=1002&akid=2226%2E346206%2E-7iQaq ]Will you chip in to support our grassroots movement so we can replace
Rand Paul? I’m going to need all the help I can get to make sure we can
build a people-powered campaign that will lift up all of our mamas and
families in Kentucky.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220715.uuxJj2&refcode=em20220715-2226&t=1021&akid=2226%2E346206%2E-7iQaq ]Contribute $5

Whenever someone asks why I decided to get involved in public service, I
remember this moment.

For generations, Kentuckians have been waiting for change and hoping that
things might get better. But it’s clear to me now that the change we’ve
been waiting for will never happen unless we fight for it.

That’s why it’s critical we organize in every corner of Kentucky and make
sure we have the grassroots support it’ll take to defeat Rand Paul. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220715.uuxJj2&refcode=em20220715-2226&t=1022&akid=2226%2E346206%2E-7iQaq ]If
you’re with me in this fight,
Peter, I hope you can make a
donation today.

Together,

Charles Booker

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, it’s
happening again. Joe Manchin and corporate Democrats are failing to invest
in clean energy and tax the rich.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112013?refcode=em20220715-24298&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24298%2E1203867%2EFXa7JS ]Tweet from Washington Post journalist Jeff Stein that reads: BREAKING:
Manchin tells Dem leaders that climate, tax hikes OUT of ever-shrinking
economic package. Deficit reduction, prescription drug reform & ACA
subsidies believed still in play

Again, we are left with an "ever-shrinking economic package." This is
exactly why the Squad voted AGAINST Manchin and Gottheimer last year — to
save Build Back Better.

Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, Rashida Tlaib, Ilhan
Omar, and Ayanna Pressley all urged Democrats to make sure Manchin
couldn’t pass his bipartisan infrastructure bill last year WITHOUT also
passing Build Back Better. But the Democratic Party establishment decided
to trust Manchin and pass the infrastructure bill anyways. And now the
core and moderate Biden-approved social, economic, and environmental
policies that we desperately need are even further out of reach.

A Democratic Party that cannot tax the rich and make major investments in
the fight on climate change is not a party for the people with a vision
for the future,
Peter. We must fight to
transform the Party, protect the Squad, and expand our bloc of Justice
Democrats in Congress to advance critical progressive policies.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112013?refcode=em20220715-24298&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=24298%2E1203867%2EFXa7JS ]Support our fight with a $3 contribution today so we
can re-elect the Squad, expand our movement, and win the transformative
action we need in America.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112013?refcode=em20220715-24298&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=24298%2E1203867%2EFXa7JS ]Contribute

Joe Manchin takes more fossil fuel campaign contributions than anyone else
in D.C. It’s obvious why he’d want to stop legislation to fund a just
transition away from oil and gas. Unfortunately, this isn’t just a problem
with Joe Manchin.

Corporate Democrats all receive massive amounts of campaign money from
corporations and Wall Street. They are all more willing to listen to the
corporate lobbyists who care about profits than the people they’re
supposed to represent. And that’s a big reason why Democrats passed
Manchin’s bipartisan infrastructure bill, giving away all leverage over
climate policy, taxing the rich, and a broad swath of social and economic
measures for working people.

Justice Democrats in Congress are the leaders who will not give in to
corporate lobbyists and who will always fight for the people.

Congress, and fundamentally change the Democratic Party. We rely 100% on
your grassroots support to take on the corporate-backed establishment.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

body:
Team,

I just wanted to make sure you saw Karen's message. November may seem a long way away, but it will be here in a blink.

These summer months are always difficult for fundraising, but we can't afford to slow down right now. Our opponent has already spent millions out of his own pocket to fuel his campaign. And we expect him to spend tens of millions _more_ in the coming months.

We rely on small donations and grassroots supporters to keep our movement going. **[Will you read Karen's message, and then chip in and help us gather the tools we need to win in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47893981/356055606/-592683541?ms=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&refcode=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&source=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=j2x2cZ%2BgfsCY4vN6kBWQUekVd15lHWux51OyavT23sYo0%2BzLdn9vCl5WM7poADohKIQJQAqcGjR%2FPpuZwNZ4tk6UVPTpJGrXT9MduwCAmvq57hnTNec4%2F2lNNFkx74wRB2AA8OGZJM8R2B7MUq5MYg%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDY4Njk3OS04OTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D4y56lL9Nh1PHXabY9IOOwfFUo64xe1xbat409OZaNQ=&emci=9d095a5d-bc03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=8d686979-8904-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)**

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Karen Bass
Date: Thu, July 14, 2022
Subject: Money can buy many things, but it can’t buy a vision.

Friend,

During this campaign, I’ve had the privilege to speak with Angelenos from all walks of life. No matter who I talk to, I hear similar sentiments again and again: we love this city and will do anything to create a bright future for the coming generations.

Team, Los Angeles has called me home, and I am ready to serve. And the fact is, I am the _only_ Democrat in this race with clear-cut goals and plans to create a safer, greener, more affordable Los Angeles.

As mayor, I will lead the city’s efforts to address our homelessness and affordable housing crises with urgency, compassion, and care. We will work to improve public safety by expanding job programs and social services. We'll prioritize climate justice so we can ensure clean air and water — especially in communities suffering most from pollution — reduce the cost of energy bills, and create new jobs.

My competitor has made some lofty promises but failed to detail his plans to make them happen. At the same time, he's already invested over $40 million of his own money into his campaign, which is likely to double by November.

**Money can buy many things,_but it can’t buy a vision._**

We can win this race in November. We can make history. Tomorrow at midnight, my campaign is facing a mid-month deadline, and I'm counting on your support.

**[Please help fund this movement we’re building together. Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $100 to power our campaign to victory?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47893982/356055607/-592683541?ms=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&refcode=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&source=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220715_MM3_fndd_gq_act___JD_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=j2x2cZ%2BgfsCY4vN6kBWQUekVd15lHWux51OyavT23sYo0%2BzLdn9vCl5WM7poADohKIQJQAqcGjR%2FPpuZwNZ4tk6UVPTpJGrXT9MduwCAmvq57hnTNec4%2F2lNNFkx74wRB2AA8OGZJM8R2B7MUq5MYg%3D%3D&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZDY4Njk3OS04OTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=D4y56lL9Nh1PHXabY9IOOwfFUo64xe1xbat409OZaNQ=&emci=9d095a5d-bc03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=8d686979-8904-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=2429742)**

Keep fighting the good fight,

Karen

Friend, During this campaign, I’ve had the privilege to speak with Angelenos from all walks of life. No matter who I talk to, I hear similar sentiments again and again: we love this city and will do anything to create a bright future for the coming generations. Team, Los Angeles has called me home, and I am ready to serve. And the fact is, I am the only Democrat in this race with clear-cut goals and plans to create a safer, greener, more affordable Los Angeles. As mayor, I will lead the city’s efforts to address our homelessness and affordable housing crises with urgency, compassion, and care. We will work to improve public safety by expanding job programs and social services. We'll prioritize climate justice so we can ensure clean air and water — especially in communities suffering most from pollution — reduce the cost of energy bills, and create new jobs. My competitor has made some lofty promises but failed to detail his plans to make them happen. At the same time, he's already invested over $40 million of his own money into his campaign, which is likely to double by November. Money can buy many things,but it can’t buy a vision. clean_body: “The most money ever raised by any U.S. Senate candidate in the first quarter of an election year.” | Fellow American, Our opponent just announced that he raised more than $17 million between April 1st and June 30th.That's THREE TIMES more than our campaign raised. We have been outraised by Senator Warnock every single quarter since I got into this race, and despite being among the top fundraisers in the Republican Party, we can't keep up. That's why I'm turning to you. If you've made a donation prior to today, I'm asking you to make another donation in the same amount or more. If you haven't yet made a donation, we NEED YOU NOW! We've got less than 120 days until Election Day, so time is running out to catch up. We should all be concerned. Writing about the massive amount of money our opponent is raising, The Atlanta Journal-Constitution says, "It further cements an enormous Democratic fundraising edge in the state's premier contests." The ability to win this race gets harder every day that we're outraised by 300%. Democrats apparently feel like they have more to lose than we do, so they're putting their money behind candidates in the toughest races. Despite what you may hear on TV from the pundits, I can't stress this enough: A Red Wave is not going to magically appear in November.We've got to FIGHT for it. I need your help. NOW. In case you do not get the Voter Pamphlet in the mail or have not had a chance to look at it online here is my Voter Pamphlet statement below. I would be honored to earn your support in this election. **[Would you please click here to share it on Facebook with your friends and family? Thank you!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47894082/356056163/-2090576885?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTUyOWZhMy04YTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jaehubOze-y_ZxeT4HvqgWzUubUwTAQV8BMTH1qAwc4=&emci=30e578b7-cf03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=5e529fa3-8a04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9494239)** **RICK LARSEN (Democrat)
Second Congressional District** **Elected Experience**
I began trying to make a difference through public service on the Snohomish County Council, and today, it is my privilege to serve as the Representative for Washington's 2nd Congressional District. **Other Professional Experience**
I was previously employed by the Port of Everett and the Washington State Dental Association. **Education**
I graduated from Pacific Lutheran University in Washington state and have a master's degree from the University of Minnesota. **Community Service**
My parents were an important influence on me, encouraging me to be involved in my local community. Their encouragement continues to be a motivation for my service to our communities. **Statement**
I am proud to serve the people of Northwest Washington. Representing your voice In Congress is the honor of a lifetime. Our region is special, and so are our neighbors. Your strength and resilience are what motivate me to fight on your behalf every day in the other Washington. Here is why our fight must continue. You deserve an economy that works for you. Passing the CARES Act in 2020 created an economy on the mend. Passing the American Rescue Plan and infrastructure bill in 2021 created an economy on the move, with low unemployment and strong economic growth. We must now focus on inflation and pass Democrats' plan to lower everyday costs, including health care, child care, and gas. You deserve limits on corporate power. This means preventing companies from generating record-high profits on your back by raising record-high prices. It means requiring all corporations to pay their fair share in taxes. And it means getting the power of big money out of our politics and returning power to you. You deserve a sustainable environment. This means protecting our natural resources, which are critical to existing local jobs that rely on our water, land, and wildlife. It also means reducing carbon emissions, which is the key both to reversing climate change and to creating future local jobs that rely on clean energy. And, with women's reproductive rights under threat, women everywhere deserve federal legislation that protects their right to choose. I was born and raised here, and my wife and I are the parents of two boys who represent the fifth generation of Larsens born in this district, I take the future of this community as personally as you do. I am committed to building an economy that creates more jobs and opportunities for all. I ask for your support. RICK LARSEN (Democrat) Second Congressional District Elected Experience I began trying to make a difference through public service on the Snohomish County Council, and today, it is my privilege to serve as the Representative for Washington's 2nd Congressional District.
