Early this spring, I took a look at the state of our state and the state of our nation as it relates to the marginalization of so many people, and knew it was time to jump into this mess so I could bring progress and possibility back to both.
Friend,

With only a few hours before our critical mid-month fundraising deadline, I wanted to reach out one final time to see if you can help us reach our must-hit goal before midnight.

Before I discuss what’s at stake in this election, and why I’m the only person you can trust in this race to be a voice of progress and possibility in Congress, please rush a donation using this secure link before our quickly approaching midnight deadline: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hava-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47894100/356056293/883222285?refcode2=2af289bb-8a04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emci=1aff381a-7703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2af289bb-8a04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&amount=5&refcode=071522-es-mm-fr-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODQ0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWYyODliYi04YTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EcXX_3soK-1QKqRTkXOcPuaEXmYFwKNY9T3Kk8erDk0=)**

Early this spring, I took a look at the state of our state and the state of our nation as it relates to the marginalization of so many people, and knew it was time to jump into this mess so I could bring progress and possibility back to both.

As the Director of the Florida Anti-Defamation League, I worked with law enforcement and schools to root out hate at its source. As a civil and workers’ rights attorney, I tackled insidious cases around age, race, and pregnancy discrimination, and fought to protect seniors from financial abuse.

I’ve seen firsthand the everyday systemic issues that hold our country back, and I’ve done the work to try to fix the system from the outside — but I realized that the best way to move our nation forward is being where the votes are taken and the decisions are made.

We must ensure women have reproductive freedom. We must end gun violence. We must reform our criminal justice system. We must invest in public education. And we must lower costs facing hardworking families in order to build a thriving economy from the middle out, not the top down.

We must elect a fighter who will confront these challenges head-on, and I’m ready to fight for you if you’ll give me a chance, friend.

Here’s that link again to pitch in for the first time to help us reach our fundraising goal to provide the resources we need to compete in this closely-contested election: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hava-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47894102/356056295/883222285?refcode2=2af289bb-8a04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emci=1aff381a-7703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2af289bb-8a04-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&amount=5&refcode=071522-es-mm-fr-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODQ0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYWYyODliYi04YTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EcXX_3soK-1QKqRTkXOcPuaEXmYFwKNY9T3Kk8erDk0=)**

Thank you for your support.

— Hava Holzhauer

name: Peter Welch
subject: There is no greater threat to progressive change in America than the filibuster. Here’s why:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
We can overcome Senate Republicans by making one basic change to the Senate rules.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=666%2E61531%2EQmIw5j)
Hello,
Throughout my career in both Vermont and Washington, I’ve been recognized for my ability to work across the aisle with my Republican colleagues. For many years, I believed there wasn’t an issue we couldn’t iron out by listening to one another and coming together on a proper solution.
I’m writing to you today because that no longer seems to be the case. Many of the progressive ideas we’ve been able to pass in the House have gotten stalled in the Senate because of Mitch McConnell, the GOP, and an outdated, abused Senate rule. Because of the filibuster, the minority is allowed to continually block progress—even on the most pressing matters—hurting Vermonters and Americans nationwide.
Abortion rights, gun control, voting rights—these are urgent issues that demand our immediate attention, but Senate Republicans won’t even budge. **There is no greater threat to progressive change in America than the filibuster, and that’s why we must abolish it immediately.**
[**We can overcome our current gridlock by making one basic change to the Senate rules. Add your name to our petition if you agree we must end the filibuster.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220715_p_p_filibuster&t=3&akid=666%2E61531%2EQmIw5j)
[SIGN MY NAME](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220715_p_p_filibuster&t=7&t=8&akid=666%2E61531%2EQmIw5j)
---
The filibuster has no place in modern-day politics. It’s a relic of the Jim Crow era, infamously used by segregationists to block civil rights. It’s eerie, and frankly sad, to see Senate Republicans use the filibuster for similar purposes in 2022.
The filibuster holds us back from doing so much good for Americans. If you send me to the Senate, I will be one more vote to end the filibuster for good.
But this isn’t a fight I can win alone. Much of what we’re fighting for has broad support from folks across Vermont and the entire country, but we still fall short when it comes down to a Senate vote. Our democracy is at stake here, and we need everyone to make their voices heard on this one.
[**If we’re going to move forward on the issues that matter to the majority of Vermonters and Americans across the country, the Senate must eliminate the filibuster. Add your name if you agree.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/signup/em-end-filibuster?source=em_20220715_p_p_filibuster&t=4&akid=666%2E61531%2EQmIw5j)
Thanks again for all you do,
Peter

It’s a relic of the Jim Crow era, infamously used by segregationists to block civil rights. It’s eerie, and frankly sad, to see Senate Republicans use the filibuster for similar purposes in 2022. The filibuster holds us back from doing so much good for Americans. If you send me to the Senate, I will be one more vote to end the filibuster for good. But this isn’t a fight I can win alone. Much of what we’re fighting for has broad support from folks across Vermont and the entire country, but we still fall short when it comes down to a Senate vote. Our democracy is at stake here, and we need everyone to make their voices heard on this one. Thanks again for all you do, Peter | | | | ---|---|--- PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT Welch for Vermont P.O Box 909 Richmond, VT 05477

| | Folks, Critical issues, from gun control to reproductive freedom, are on the ballot this fall. But rather than let the voters decide the direction of those issues, anti-voter politicians in Georgia and nationwide are launching an unprecedented number of attacks on the freedom to vote — especially among Black, brown, and younger voters. So we need to take action _now_ on some very specific steps to protect access to the ballot. The team at Fair Fight Action has a plan, and we rely on supporters like you to put it into action. [**We’ve got a goal of raising $20,000 before midnight tonight to fund our voter education and voter protection programs — and we’re 64% there. Will you chip in to help hit this goal and fight for free and fair elections and prepare for the midterms in four months?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47895491/356059445/-1864421074?refcode=em_20220715_f_f_goals_s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMjQxZDhlYS04ZTA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HLUcajhyvdDEWFCKSy7TUHYpsu4TZdBjddf9nhZk5Jg=) The voter suppression playbook is easy to read. Anti-voter politicians are threatened by the power of the people — especially after we saw historic voter turnout in 2020 — so they’re attempting to take that power away by trying to make voting inconvenient and confusing. **We can’t let them do it.** With your help, we will push back against obstacles like long lines, rejected absentee ballots, disinformation, and polling location closures. Our team will fight every nefarious tactic of anti-voter politicians with everything we’ve got — from anti-disinformation monitoring and response, to lawsuits in court. But to do that, we’ll need strong resources. [**Can you please give $25 before midnight tonight? Fighting for free and fair elections can’t wait until Election Day; the work is happening _right now_. body:
State Freedom Caucus Action | | | |
---
| | | | **The Time to Fight is Now**
---
| The**fight for freedom** is underway. Americans are rising up all over the nation to return power back to hardworking families and citizens. The radical left and their establishment enablers, however, are refusing to relinquish control and doubling down on their destructive vision: **skyrocketing inflation, out-of-control crime, a wide-open border** controlled by murderous drug cartels, **schools filled with radical Marxists** pushing divisive and harmful ideologies on race and biology, and**families crushed** by increasing costs of gasoline and home energy bills.

The time for **conservative and common sense patriots** to band together and seize back control of our communities, our institutions, and our legislatures has arrived. It is precisely for this mission and this moment that **State Freedom Caucus Action** exists.

As part of the broader State Freedom Caucus Network, SFC Action works to protect conservative state lawmakers from the well-financed and targeted political attacks of the establishment and their cronies. SFC Action does this by **providing the resources and strategies conservative state legislators need** to fend off challenges from left-leaning primary candidates as well as defeat longstanding incumbents who no longer fight for their constituents and advance progressive agendas in the state house.

Conservative candidates are routinely outgunned and outspent by political money that pours in from corporate boardrooms, wealthy left-leaning business owners, immoral Hollywood elites, and unscrupulous progressive entities focused on achieving their Marxist ends.

For too long, **conservatives have watched helplessly** as good candidates and lawmakers are attacked for daring to stand up for their constituents–not just by far-left propagandists in the media–but also by these wealthy interests aligned with the bipartisan establishment. Whether it's in Washington D.C. or state capitols, establishment politicians are more interested in perpetuating a status quo than meeting the needs of the working and middle-class patriots who elect them.

**With your help, those days are over.**

State Freedom Caucus Action is changing this dynamic by providing the targeted political resources needed to protect the freedom fighters elected to state legislatures. We are seizing new ground in state capitols all over America as well as retaining and expanding upon existing freedom caucus power in states like Georgia, Mississippi, Illinois, Nevada, and South Carolina.

When conservatives threaten to clean up the greased skids of corrupt political power, establishment forces predictably unleash money from their woke corporate backers, utilize deceptive attacks to drive away otherwise supportive voters, and unleash sickening smears to drive good people out of public service.

But the gig is up. The American people have caught on to their playbook. What the far-left and the establishment fear is that you will fight back.

**Will you do just that and help us defeat them?**

Will you help ensure good conservatives are **empowered and elected to wage and win the economic and cultural battles** in their respective state capitols so that our states, our communities, and our neighborhoods can remain free?

Even in **deeply red states** , conservative lawmakers often find themselves outgunned and outmanned by long-time establishment Republicans dedicated to preserving their power and doling out political favors instead of protecting their constituents from the radicalism of today’s Democrat party.

**Let’s send the radical left and the establishment a message they cannot ignore. Will you consider helping our efforts? Even[$10](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=698746c0be&e=64ecec6d03), [$25](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=f026f320d3&e=64ecec6d03), or [$50](https://statefreedomcaucus.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a363d70ccaaebc9e5732e6783&id=0101198fef&e=64ecec6d03) will make a huge difference in our efforts to expand the fight for freedom to your state legislature and protect the lawmakers dedicated to advancing liberty!

Thanks to your help and your commitment to the ideas that have made America the indispensable nation, we know we will win.**

Keep fighting,

Andy Roth
President
State Freedom Caucus Network

| | I feel the biggest obstacle to Doug’s campaign is the ingrained belief that the 4th Congressional District is solidly Republican and a Democrat cannot win. After reviewing voter registration data and statistics for the 4th Congressional district, Doug does not believe that is the case. According to Doug's campaign:
* There are 390,000 registered voters in the 4th district.
* 48,000 are flagged as likely Republican or consistently vote Republican
* 56000 are flagged as likely Democratic or consistently vote Democratic
* 35,000 are flagged as likely Independent with either a Democratic or Republican lean

For the other 251,000, there's either no data (because they are registered but don't vote in any partisan races) or their preference isn't predictable As you can see, there are not that many registered voters in this district who will consistently vote for a straight Republican ticket. There are, in fact, more voters who will consistently vote for a straight Democratic ticket. You could ask then: How do Republicans consistently win? We believe it's because this area is very conservative, not Republican, and a lot of people vote based on a general impression of who will win. It's an emotional choice, not necessarily a logical one. To that end, we are not targeting voters based on party. We are largely targeting voters that consider themselves Independent and have voted for both Republicans and Democrats. Again, we believe this isn't a solidly ‘red’ district, it's a solidly ‘conservative’ district. A lot of that ‘conservatism’ is just ‘pragmatism,’ and we believe it's likely that pragmatic voters will realize that the current group of Republican candidates aren't practical small-government conservatives; they are ideological extremists who we believe everyone is tired of. However, there's a very specific type of voter that wants more of that; but that voter is not in the majority in our fair district. In a lot of areas in our district, the vast majority of eligible voters either aren't registered or are non-participatory. Take Pasco, for example, where only about 15-20% of eligible voters actively participate yearly. As a campaign, we strongly believe that if those voters saw a message they could identify with, they would show up. A marginal turnout rate above what we normally see could change this district. I truly believe this team has a path to victory, which seems to be playing out; Doug is leading in the polls and fundraising. Please take a few moments to visit Doug’s website, watch the short video, and read his campaign Vision Statement: [https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/vision](https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/so/16O7vtOa4/c?w=6Lv46lRGChvI45I-9mt8_wlpaKvV5D1AUFLYa6PBSl0.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9uYW0xMi5zYWZlbGlua3MucHJvdGVjdGlvbi5vdXRsb29rLmNvbS8_)

| | Creo que el mayor obstáculo para la campaña de Doug es la creencia muy arraigada de que el 4o Distrito del Congreso es firmemente republicano y que un demócrata no puede ganar. Después de revisar los datos de registro de votantes y las estadísticas del 4o distrito del Congreso, Doug no cree que ese sea el caso.Según la campaña de Doug: Hay 390.000 votantes registrados en el 4o distrito.
48.000 están marcados como probables republicanos o votan regularmente por el partido republicano
56.000 están marcados como probables demócratas o votan regularmente a favor de los demócratas
35.000 están marcados como probables independientes con una inclinación demócrata o republicana
Para los otros 251.000, o bien no hay datos (porque están registrados pero no votan en ninguna elección partidista) o bien su preferencia no es determinable. Como puede ver, no hay muchos votantes registrados en este distrito que voten regularmente por una candidatura republicana. De hecho, hay más votantes que votan regularmente por una candidatura demócrata. Se podría preguntar entonces: ¿Cómo es que los republicanos ganan sistemáticamente? Creemos que es porque esta zona es muy conservadora, no republicana, y mucha gente vota basándose en una impresión general de quién va a ganar. Es una elección emocional, no necesariamente lógica. Para ello, no nos dirigimos a los votantes en función del partido. Nos dirigimos principalmente a los votantes que se consideran independientes y que han votado tanto por los republicanos como por los demócratas. De nuevo, creemos que este no es un distrito exclusivamente "rojo", sino que es un distrito exclusivamente "conservador". Gran parte de ese " conservatismo " es simplemente " pragmatismo ", y creemos que es probable que los votantes pragmáticos se den cuenta de que el grupo actual de candidatos republicanos no son conservadores prácticos de gobierno pequeño; son extremistas ideológicos de los que creemos que todo el mundo está cansado. Sin embargo, hay un tipo muy específico de votante que quiere más de eso; pero ese votante no es la mayoría en nuestro justo distrito. En muchas zonas de nuestro distrito, la gran mayoría de los votantes elegibles no están registrados o no participan. Por ejemplo, en Pasco, donde sólo entre el 15 y el 20% de los votantes con derecho a voto participan activamente cada año. Como campaña, creemos firmemente que si esos votantes vieran un mensaje con el que se identificaran, participarían. Una cifra de participación marginal por encima de lo que vemos normalmente podría cambiar este distrito. Realmente creo que este equipo tiene un camino a la victoria, que parece estar desarrollando; Doug está liderando en las encuestas y la recaudación de fondos. Por favor, tómese unos minutos para visitar el sitio web de Doug, ver el video corto, y leer su declaración de visión de la campaña: [https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/vision](https://www.dougwhite4congress.us/so/16O7vtOa4/c?w=4S2-L3wmmbmMZKPypZACWJZrJK6E3fci-ReRzDtP2LE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9uYW0xMi5zYWZlbGlua3MucHJvdGVjdGlvbi5vdXRsb29rLmNvbS8_)

Por qué ganaremos! | | | | I feel the biggest obstacle to Doug’s campaign is the ingrained belief that the 4th Congressional District is solidly Republican and a Democrat cannot win. After reviewing voter registration data and statistics for the 4th Congressional district, Doug does not believe that is the case. According to Doug's campaign: There are 390,000 registered voters in the 4th district. 48,000 are flagged as likely Republican or consistently vote Republican 56000 are flagged as likely Democratic or consistently vote Democratic 35,000 are flagged as likely Independent with either a Democratic or Republican lean For the other 251,000, there's either no data (because they are registered but don't vote in any partisan races) or their preference isn't predictable As you can see, there are not that many registered voters in this district who will consistently vote for a straight Republican ticket. There are, in fact, more voters who will consistently vote for a straight Democratic ticket. You could ask then: How do Republicans consistently win? We believe it's because this area is very conservative, not Republican, and a lot of people vote based on a general impression of who will win. It's an emotional choice, not necessarily a logical one. To that end, we are not targeting voters based on party. We are largely targeting voters that consider themselves Independent and have voted for both Republicans and Democrats. Again, we believe this isn't a solidly ‘red’ district, it's a solidly ‘conservative’ district. A lot of that ‘conservatism’ is just ‘pragmatism,’ and we believe it's likely that pragmatic voters will realize that the current group of Republican candidates aren't practical small-government conservatives; they are ideological extremists who we believe everyone is tired of. However, there's a very specific type of voter that wants more of that; but that voter is not in the majority in our fair district. In a lot of areas in our district, the vast majority of eligible voters either aren't registered or are non-participatory. Take Pasco, for example, where only about 15-20% of eligible voters actively participate yearly. As a campaign, we strongly believe that if those voters saw a message they could identify with, they would show up. A marginal turnout rate above what we normally see could change this district. I truly believe this team has a path to victory, which seems to be playing out; Doug is leading in the polls and fundraising. Please take a few moments to visit Doug’s website, watch the short video, and read his campaign Vision Statement: | | Creo que el mayor obstáculo para la campaña de Doug es la creencia muy arraigada de que el 4o Distrito del Congreso es firmemente republicano y que un demócrata no puede ganar. name: Tanisha Sullivan
subject: I’m fighting with working families in Massachusetts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Tanisha M
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tanisha4ma?refcode=email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tanisha4ma?refcode=email]
ICYMI, this week I received endorsements from three big labor unions, 1199SEIU , SEIU 509 and the Greater Boston Building Trades Unions (GBTTU) , representing nearly 130,000 working families across Massachusetts.
Together, the two SEIU locals represent nearly 100,000 healthcare, home care, human service workers, state workers, and childcare providers across the Commonwealth. GBBTU is an umbrella group of 20 local construction unions which, in partnership with more than 3,300 union contractors, provides the highest standards for workers in the construction industry.
"SEIU 509 is proud to endorse Tanisha Sullivan to be the next Secretary of State. Our movement is strongest when we exercise our power at the ballot box to elect leaders who share our values. For far too long, many of our neighbors have been left out of the voting process because of outdated and inequitable policies,” said Peter MacKinnon, President of the SEIU Massachusetts State Council and SEIU Local 509 . “Tanisha Sullivan is committed to removing the barriers to voting that hold our communities back from making their voices heard.”
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/97312/images/tanishaendorsement1.jpeg]
Tanisha with Brian Doherty, GBBTU
“The healthcare workers of 1199SEIU are proud to stand with Tanisha Sullivan for secretary of state,” said Filaine Deronnette, 1199SEIU vice president-at-large . “At a time when we must protect the integrity of our elections, it is also an opportunity to reimagine how we create a more engaged and representative electorate that elevates the voices of working people and people of color. Just as she has done throughout her career, Tanisha is that champion who will help create a Massachusetts that works for all.”
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/97312/images/tanishaendorsement2.jpeg] “Tanisha Sullivan has proven to be a strong champion of our democracy in her push to secure and expand voting rights in Massachusetts. Her commitment to increasing shared economic prosperity and creating a level playing field for everyone in the commonwealth puts her squarely on the side of working people,” said Brian Doherty, General Agent of the Greater Boston Building Trades Unions.
“In her capacity as president of the Boston NAACP and in her advocacy work, Tanisha has focused on fairness and equity throughout her career. She’ll fight to ensure workers across our state have access to good union jobs that provide family-sustaining wages, health insurance, retirement security, safe working conditions and a voice at work.”
I am honored to have the members of these organizations believing in the hope and possibility of this moment, and their readiness to fight with me to deliver the democracy working people and families across Massachusetts deserve.
In solidarity,
Tanisha

clean_body: [] ICYMI, this week I received endorsements from three big labor unions, 1199SEIU , SEIU 509 and the Greater Boston Building Trades Unions (GBTTU) , representing nearly 130,000 working families across Massachusetts. Together, the two SEIU locals represent nearly 100,000 healthcare, home care, human service workers, state workers, and childcare providers across the Commonwealth. GBBTU is an umbrella group of 20 local construction unions which, in partnership with more than 3,300 union contractors, provides the highest standards for workers in the construction industry. "SEIU 509 is proud to endorse Tanisha Sullivan to be the next Secretary of State. Our movement is strongest when we exercise our power at the ballot box to elect leaders who share our values. For far too long, many of our neighbors have been left out of the voting process because of outdated and inequitable policies,” said Peter MacKinnon, President of the SEIU Massachusetts State Council and SEIU Local 509 . “Tanisha Sullivan is committed to removing the barriers to voting that hold our communities back from making their voices heard.” [] Tanisha with Brian Doherty, GBBTU “The healthcare workers of 1199SEIU are proud to stand with Tanisha Sullivan for secretary of state,” said Filaine Deronnette, 1199SEIU vice president-at-large . “At a time when we must protect the integrity of our elections, it is also an opportunity to reimagine how we create a more engaged and representative electorate that elevates the voices of working people and people of color. Just as she has done throughout her career, Tanisha is that champion who will help create a Massachusetts that works for all.” [] “Tanisha Sullivan has proven to be a strong champion of our democracy in her push to secure and expand voting rights in Massachusetts. Her commitment to increasing shared economic prosperity and creating a level playing field for everyone in the commonwealth puts her squarely on the side of working people,” said Brian Doherty, General Agent of the Greater Boston Building Trades Unions. “In her capacity as president of the Boston NAACP and in her advocacy work, Tanisha has focused on fairness and equity throughout her career. She’ll fight to ensure workers across our state have access to good union jobs that provide family-sustaining wages, health insurance, retirement security, safe working conditions and a voice at work.” I am honored to have the members of these organizations believing in the hope and possibility of this moment, and their readiness to fight with me to deliver the democracy working people and families across Massachusetts deserve. body:
Today Brenda received another big endorsement. We are so.... | | |
---
| | **Our team is so excited to that Brenda received a nod from one of the key grassroots organizations in Vermont that works on protecting our environment, Vermont Conservation Voters announced their endorsement of Brenda Siegel for Governor today.** **“With Vermont facing urgent challenges like climate change, we need leaders with a strong vision for the future - not leaders who govern by the veto pen. Unfortunately, Governor Scott has vetoed the two most significant climate bills that have reached his desk, and also vetoed bills to protect our forests and conserve our land and waters for now and future generations,” said Lauren Hierl, Executive Director of Vermont Conservation Voters. ** **Brenda’s climate plan is centered around bold climate action that meets the standards set by the Global Warming Solutions Act. Bold climate action means transitioning to in state renewable energy. It means supporting our small farms to transition to carbon sequestration. It means cutting our dependence on fossil fuels and no longer investing in them as well. It means investing in expanded public transit. Brenda knows that we have to get serious about protecting our earth and the future for our children.** **We are so excited about the momentum this race is gaining, but we need you to keep going. We need you to [Donate](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=4047e45ef7&e=eb0e94ee98) $50 to support Brenda’s plan for bold climate action.**

---
| [ ](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=55f8135a58&e=eb0e94ee98)
---
| **“With the radicalized Supreme Court and the thwarting of national action on climate this past week, Vermont must lead on this issue. The climate crisis can not wait. We have to do better. I am so honored to receive this endorsement and looking forward as Governor to working to support Bold Climate Action." Brenda said earlier today.** ** It is up to all of us to join together and ensure that we have a Governor that will lead us towards progress and not be a constant hinderance to saving our planet. ** **Our team is working day and night to ensure Vermonters have the best future possible. With your[donation of $100](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=f075f5bfae&e=eb0e94ee98), we know that Brenda can win this race. Today, we need your endorsement of Brenda as a climate champion! **

**Solidarity,

Jacob Elpern
Campaign Manager, Brenda For Vermont**

It means investing in expanded public transit. Brenda knows that we have to get serious about protecting our earth and the future for our children. We are so excited about the momentum this race is gaining, but we need you to keep going. Brenda said earlier today. It is up to all of us to join together and ensure that we have a Governor that will lead us towards progress and not be a constant hinderance to saving our planet. Our team is working day and night to ensure Vermonters have the best future possible. With your, we know that Brenda can win this race. Greetings from Ohio,

This is **Bria Bennett running for OH HD-64** and **Daniel Ortiz running for OH HD-43.** We’re reaching out to you together today because early voting has already started here in the buckeye state, so time is of the essence.

Where the federal government has yet to take bold enough action, it’s more important than ever that we have strong state legislatures defending our basic human rights and working to keep us safe.

**This year, there is so much on the line — and on the ballot.** Among the plethora of crises our country is facing, abortion access and gun violence are currently at top of mind for many Americans. _So we want to take a moment to give you a glimpse of how these issues look in our state right now._

Almost exactly one month ago, a brand new gun law went into effect in Ohio that permits concealed carry of weapons — **_without a license, background check, or training._** We’re facing a gun violence epidemic, and now Ohioans must live in fear that anywhere they go, anyone they pass could be carrying a weapon — including those without any qualifications to handle one.

And in the wake of the devastating overturning of Roe v. Wade, Ohio Republicans have just introduced a bill earlier this week that would **_outlaw ALL abortions_ with the only exception being when the life of the mother is “endangered”, by their definition of the word.

****Ohio and several other states are moving the entire country in the wrong direction.** Instead of prioritizing our safety and justice, they are putting people’s livelihoods at risk to fulfill the far-right agenda. We cannot let this continue. We must fight back by using our voices through our elections to demand leaders who will stand up against corporate interests, corruption, and extremism and actually get things done for working families. **_That’s what we both vow to do if we are elected to the Ohio State House.

clean_body: Friends, there is so much on the line — and on the ballot. | | | Greetings from Ohio, This is Bria Bennett running for OH HD-64 and Daniel Ortiz running for OH HD-43. We’re reaching out to you together today because early voting has already started here in the buckeye state, so time is of the essence. Where the federal government has yet to take bold enough action, it’s more important than ever that we have strong state legislatures defending our basic human rights and working to keep us safe. This year, there is so much on the line — and on the ballot. Among the plethora of crises our country is facing, abortion access and gun violence are currently at top of mind for many Americans. So we want to take a moment to give you a glimpse of how these issues look in our state right now. Almost exactly one month ago, a brand new gun law went into effect in Ohio that permits concealed carry of weapons — without a license, background check, or training. We’re facing a gun violence epidemic, and now Ohioans must live in fear that anywhere they go, anyone they pass could be carrying a weapon — including those without any qualifications to handle one. And in the wake of the devastating overturning of Roe v. Wade, Ohio Republicans have just introduced a bill earlier this week that would outlaw ALL abortions with the only exception being when the life of the mother is “endangered”, by their definition of the word. Ohio and several other states are moving the entire country in the wrong direction. Instead of prioritizing our safety and justice, they are putting people’s livelihoods at risk to fulfill the far-right agenda. We cannot let this continue. We must fight back by using our voices through our elections to demand leaders who will stand up against corporate interests, corruption, and extremism and actually get things done for working families. That’s what we both vow to do if we are elected to the Ohio State House. Before we get there though, we need your help. ** Dominic Rapini Blasts Lamont on Suspension of Supervised Balloting at Nursing Homes
------------------------------------------------------------
https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=4580989c43&e=8763c56857

BRANFORD, Conn—Dominic Rapini – the Republican endorsed candidate for Secretary of the State - blasted Governor Ned Lamont on his suspension of supervised absentee ballot voting for the August 9, 2022 primary.

“How we conduct our elections matters. We have supervised absentee voting for a reason,” Dominic Rapini said. “The suspension compromises the integrity of the vote and opens the door for fraud and abuse.”

There are about 20,000 residents in Connecticut’s nursing homes and this measure will directly affect all of them. There are common-sense solutions that we can implement that will protect the health of our most vulnerable while protecting the sanctity of their vote.

“Connecticut elections are already tainted by stories of missing & magically appearing ballots, polling stations open past 8:00 pm, and landlords in Bridgeport that steal their tenants’ identities to create fake absentee ballots. Governor Lamont’s action this week is just another chapter in the legacy of Connecticut Elections.”

Rapini concluded: With so many problems, now we know why Governor Lamont is trying to hire a Ministry of Truth.

###

** Lee Elci & Dominic Rapini Discuss Lamont Stopping Supervised Balloting in Nursing Homes
------------------------------------------------------------
https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=2b31b9bd2a&e=8763c56857

Dominic Rapini and Lee Elci discuss the possibility of abuse of voting in nursing homes as Governor Lamont suspends election officials from supervising the voting process.

To listen to the interview, click here (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=945404ee6a&e=8763c56857) .

subject: Join Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, Ed Gainey in Pittsburgh at the country's largest annual progressive gathering.

body:
https://www.kpef.info/ [https://www.kpef.info/]

Dear Friend,

We're so excited to share that the 17th annual Netroots Nation conference is coming to Pittsburgh from August 18-20!

Keystone will be there and you should join us at this largest annual progressive gathering in the country to learn, connect, and be inspired.

With more than 140 hours of programming, Netroots Nation features inspiring keynotes — Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar and Ed Gainey are just a few of the confirmed speakers — engaging panels, cutting-edge training sessions, and opportunities to connect with progressive activists from across the country.

There’s a discounted rate for locals, too. Register now and get 40% off of any ticket level. [https://registration.socio.events/e/netroots22/promo-codes/PGHLOCALS]

Need a scholarship or interested in volunteering? Click here to apply for one or to sign up. [https://www.netrootsnation.org/faq/scholarships/]

This year's agenda includes conversations about the upcoming midterms and strategies to win ; conversations about protecting our democracy ; and sessions digging into pressing issues — from abortion access and policing to climate change and gun reform . There’s also tons of content highlighting the organizing and activism happening in Pittsburgh and throughout the state.

Here’s just a few of the locals-led, Pennsylvania-focused panels on the agenda:

- Why We're Winning: How Black-Led Progressive Organizations are Changing the Face of Western PA Politics
[https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/why-were-winning-how-black-led-progressive-organizations-are-changing-the-face-of-western-pa-politics/]

- Public Safety vs. Policing: They are Not One and the Same!
[https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/public-safety-vs-policing-they-are-not-one-and-the-same/]

- Pennsylvania’s Plan to Take on the Corporations Harming Our Democracy
[https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/pennsylvanias-plan-to-take-on-the-corporations-harming-our-democracy/]

- Building a Movement for Gun Violence Prevention
[https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/building-a-movement-for-gun-violence-prevention/]

The Intersections of the Supreme Court's Decision on Abortion Rights
[https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/the-intersections-of-the-supreme-courts-decision-on-abortion-rights/]

Cross Culture Collaboration in Times of Crisis
[https://www.netrootsnation.org/nn_events/nn22/cross-culture-collaboration-in-times-of-crisis/]

You can peek at the full agenda here [https://www.netrootsnation.org/agenda/] . Speakers and sessions are being added every day. And see what others have to say [https://www.netrootsnation.org/testimonials/] about attending Netroots Nation.

Connecting at Netroots Nation will provide the inspiration and energy we all need to keep doing our important work. And given the recent Supreme Court rulings, current events, and upcoming midterms, it’s more important than ever.

I hope to see you there!

Laura Nevitt
Executive Director
Keystone Progress

#

Hi there, it's Alex.
I’m writing today to ask you to make a donation to Tom Perez’s campaign for governor in Maryland.
I’ll explain more in a minute, but Tom’s primary is this Tuesday, so please use this link to make a donation right away if you can afford to do so:
[**https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/Tom-Perez**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22-perez.7toCEl&refcode=em220715-1-30&t=1&akid=892%2E159979%2ENnVrGX)
Ok, here’s the deal:
Like me, Tom is the son of immigrants to the United States. And like me, Tom dedicated himself to his education, putting himself through college with the help of the Pell Grant program and a series of odd jobs — including working on the back of a garbage truck.
Tom knows the value of hard work, and as Governor he will fight for good jobs, affordable health care, racial equity, and quality public education for all, just like he has his entire career.
His campaign has a ton of energy heading into Election Day, and he’s been endorsed by _The Washington Post_ , _The Baltimore Sun_ , _El Tiempo Latino_ , and the vast majority of unions throughout the state.
You may not think of Maryland as a “red state,” but for the past eight years, Maryland has had a Republican governor blocking a lot of progressive ideas. Tom is our best shot at flipping this state blue.
In a race as close as this one, we cannot take anything for granted. And the truth is Tom is counting on grassroots supporters like you to push his campaign over the finish line on Election Day. So we are asking:
[**Can you please help ride the momenTOM into Election Day by making a $5 donation? There are just a few days left to get out the vote, so anything you can chip in today makes a BIG difference.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-july22-perez.7toCEl&refcode=em220715-1-30&t=2&akid=892%2E159979%2ENnVrGX)

Thank you,
Alex Padilla

_Senator Padilla is asking for contributions to Tom Perez’s campaign of up to $2,900 from individuals and other sources permitted under federal law. He is not asking for any funds from corporations, labor unions, federal contractors, or foreign nationals. Such contributions will not be accepted._

clean_body: | | | We need to be ready for November | | | Team, early voting is in full swing for our August 2nd primary! As we told you before, we’re launching a Latino community primary voter outreach program. Our research shows that 94 percent of Latino voters who vote in a primary, return to vote in a general election. If we can boost primary voting, we can boost general election voting as well! After we updated you recently about the program, a generous donor has stepped up to match all donations to this program up to $10,000. That means if we can get our grassroots team to donate, we can double our impact and grow this program. The primary is also a good time to put our field and organizing teams to work. Unlike other states, Arizona has a late primary. Once the primary is over, it’ll be a 90-day sprint to the general election. This is also an opportunity to get our organizers real training on Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts, before the general election. With early voting already underway and the majority of Arizonans voting early, we need the resources to launch this program right away! clean_body: | | | Friend, I’m afraid some people don’t know the power of their voice. They think that it is impossible for Republicans to win in districts that Democrats have long controlled. That their voice cannot change the outcome when faced against all odds. I’m here to tell you that’s not true. Your voice can make an enormous impact. Candidates win because of the people who show up to the polls and make their voices heard. That’s why even in races where the candidate is facing an uphill battle against a 30-year incumbent and in districts that have been held by Democrats for decades, Being an underdog myself on many occasions, I can assure you underdogs can shock the world. Our endorsed candidates need a community of brave patriots fighting alongside them to make it across the finish line. That’s why I’m training, advising, endorsing, and financially supporting strong conservatives across the country — even in races where it may seem like an uphill battle. | | | Take NV-03 for example. A Republican hasn’t won NV-03 since 2014. Democrat Susie Lee raised $1.1 million in the second quarter this year. But Republican April Becker is gearing up for victory. | | She knows the people of her district care about rising prices at the pump and skyrocketing inflation and she’s armed with solutions to tackle these issues. Her message is working. She may be the underdog, but she’s an underdog with solutions. Rep. Susie Lee knows April Becker’s message is resonating with voters and announced half a million dollars in ad buys to try and defeat her. This race is a TOSS UP that underdog April Becker can win if people step up and rally behind her. | | | In KS-03 Amanda Adkins is running against incumbent Democrat Sharice Davids. Sharice Davids won her last two elections by nearly 10 points. Democrats want you to think this seat is in the bag for them in November. But this race is rated as a TOSS UP. | | Republican April Becker CAN win if she has the resources to connect with voters and get her message out. | | | Or look at Tiffany Smiley in Washington. Tiffany Smiley is running for Senate in Washington against a 30-year liberal incumbent. Earlier this year, Democrats thought Washington was a lock for them, but Tiffany Smiley is proving them wrong. | | Not only did she raise an astounding $2.6 million in the second quarter of the year, she is also gaining ground in the polls. Democrats are petrified of losing this seat. That’s why liberal Democrat Patty Murray launched attack ads against Smiley. **Hi there, Charlie Crist here.**

I wanted to write to say thank you for everything you're doing to help defeat Ron DeSantis. Florida can't afford another four years of his divisive politics in the governor's office, and I appreciate your support in this race.

Whether we have a governor who will fight climate change, protect our communities from gun violence, and defend our most precious constitutional rights will depend on the outcome of this election. Governor DeSantis wants to use the governor's office to advance an extreme, far-right agenda that he thinks will help him win the Republican nomination for president, and we can't let that happen.

But while he has out-of-state billionaires writing check after check to his campaign, I'm counting on grassroots supporters like you to pitch in anything you can to help me fight back. **_[If you can, please click here to make a donation to support my campaign today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47898386/356085054/-1259897983?amount=25&refcode=20220715_f_3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMjUzYTQ4Ny1hMDA0LWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zkwvZSVJSVLQrWuQChmv0ncqX51YMlv7WpNJmHqrpm4=)_**

Thank you again for your support. By working together, I know we can win this race and finally start to build a Florida that works for ALL Floridians.

# Erik Aadland named to Young Guns Program
---
|
---
| Today, the NRCC announced that Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, has been added to their "On the Radar" list of candidates for the strategic Young Guns Program.
"I am overjoyed to be added to this list of incredible candidates," stated Aadland. "This program chooses the best and the brightest contenders during an election cycle; I am humbled to be considered one of them. My campaign is accelerating every day and we truly have our eyes on victory in November. I can assure the NRCC that adding me to this list was the right decision, I will not let them, or the constituents in CD7, down."
The Young Guns program is an exclusive group of candidates who have been invited to participate in the program under the leadership of Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy and many other members of Congress who are dedicated to taking back the house. "There's a record-breaking class of Republican House candidates running this fall because Americans are fed up with Democrats' agenda that has led to 40-year high inflation, sky-high gas prices, a crisis at our southern border, and rampant violent crime," said Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy. "Democrats have failed the American people and done nothing but create crisis after crisis."

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

The GOP is falling in line, but we have what it takes to beat them.
#
Derek, the GOP is falling in line to try to keep PA red. 🔴
This week, Dr. Oz went on Sean Hannity to call John “crazier than you think” and spread BS lies about our movement.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220715-6537&refcode2=6537_434096_K8dzHZ&akid=6537%2E434096%2EK8dzHZ)
Remember: Oz already has Trump’s endorsement, and Mitch McConnell’s dark money super PACs are gearing up to spend TENS of million$ in our race.
Look, we have what it takes to flip this critical U.S. Senate seat blue. But the truth is, if we’re going to overcome the GOP’s dark money, BS attacks, and Fox News propaganda machine, we can’t afford to fall short on a *single* fundraising goal.
That’s why we’re emailing you right now. Tonight is our mid-month fundraising deadline, and we’re in a bit of a summer fundraising slump. So we’ve gotta ask:
[**_Can you pitch in to support John Fetterman today? We just ran the numbers, and if just 3 folks from 18326 can give today, we’ll get back on pace with our monthly fundraising before the clock strikes midnight._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220715-6537&refcode2=6537_434096_K8dzHZ&akid=6537%2E434096%2EK8dzHZ)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220715-6537&refcode2=6537_434096_K8dzHZ&akid=6537%2E434096%2EK8dzHZ)**
Believe it or not, our fundraising goals we set are never arbitrary. There's actually a lot of math* involved!
Each month, we calculate *exactly* how much money we must raise in order to scale up our field organizing, host campaign events across the Commonwealth, get ads with John’s message on the air, and much more.
Your donation today is even more critical than usual, because it’ll help us fight back against Oz’s baseless attacks on Fox News! Like John said on Wednesday night, we’re not gonna just sit back + let him drag our campaign through the mud.
[**_So, Derek, please consider chipping in._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220715-2?refcode=em20220715-6537&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6537_434096_K8dzHZ&akid=6537%2E434096%2EK8dzHZ) No matter the amount you can spare today, even if it’s just a few bucks, we’re so grateful to each + every person who’s donated to build a campaign that is so truly special.
Let’s win this,
Team Fetterman

| | | | | Peter, **Disinformation is still killing this country.** Forty percent of a group of the highest paid Americans cannot cross the border into Canada because they are still unvaccinated. I'm talking about the Kansas City Royals baseball team, not traders at Goldman Sachs or partners at a high-priced law firm. Yet, even lacking the education of the latter two groups, Kansas City Royals players possess disposable income, leisure time, they travel, all the kidns of things that equal access to any source of information they wish to acquire. **[PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc606f2a7-eba3-4258-b0c0-ffc835b9d651/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Ten of the 26 players on the active roster have chosen not to get a simple few second needle in their arm, the kind of thing Americans did/have done to stop smallpox, typhoid, tetanus, whooping cough, polio and so many ohter even more deadly diseases. And this is because of the power of right-wing propaganda. Make no mistake, there was no mass-movement against vaccination for COVID until FoxNews, Joe Rogan, Alex Jones, Sinclair Media, Salem Media, Donald Trump, Ron Johnson, Ted Cruz and many others found it profitable and a source of power to demagogue about masks and vaccines. [PLEASE WATCH MY VIDEO ON THIS TRAVESTY](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8570e665-ee26-42cb-b0ff-ebca626eea00/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) As I talk about [in my newest Youtube video](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6b2c40c6-e18b-4c4d-afc6-8131793f01ba/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) at [The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf3f88473-04d1-4abe-8334-f5c62a0b403c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). This is a problme _we need to solve_. As I ask: _**Why would we have an anti-American, Putin-talking-point spouting channel on at our military bases. WHY??...We're going to have to deal with the fact that we have people who don't live in this reality. And if they don't live int his reality, they are not taking the precautions this reality requires. And that puts us all at risk...We need to solve this disinformation problem, where people knowing share fake information that gets people killed...**_ [Please watch the rest of the video](https://default.salsalabs.org/T1839577d-d758-4c35-9d64-c352d4a05905/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and [subscribe to the Youtube Channel! ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdbd4461e-1854-46eb-8b94-ecee19f0f005/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)Where you can find many more informative, (hopefully) sometimes funny and often righteous videos about the state of the scurrilous right wing in America, as well as our media's failure to tell it like it is. [PLEASE SUBSCRIBE TO THE TAKEDOWN W/ CLIFF SCHECTER](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tea5aca64-7940-48d5-a0df-c268469e2bee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you! And have a great weekend. All my best, Cliff

Peter,

When I was commissioned into the Marine Corps more than ten years ago, it was for a multitude of reasons. I was inspired to take action, protect our country, and answer a call for public service. I believed America was worth protecting, _and I still do_.

[**These are the same motivations that have driven me to run for Congress today.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e17469c3c5a649468217a51c73d673d5&_e=C-Kp7LH4qPqoK6swDAJngIKcRCk-vfnLA79670sMCVqN_UXLuFeRAZvS4lvaHwiG24hJiG9tMBL8To8-l7BGhpNG1lTxfHXJw0cNrGUx1bzViMh2J1brnEn1P-OyBh0D7RUO1OJhCL1N7ohjcI4wlqf-HJATV-sstku07KokNJMbXNOn75TbOdz6l7pHYOfHqxvTQ0yz7UsPIzk-6ggNTuB1T85BGG1CkmdlqnkRksLN1xp-xwyIFqXEF3Es0ewThRISQjfXIh2iYG_60NFivpOcqUewaFB1-ErFnVe9Qub096uD4gLfMX3mqGSqzESErrPKMNJAMrvvA0AT2BbGvyIYBDKP2JVlHTBvxc8QR2AF3vNOeu177T-SRi8DkYBw2LGKzzd-1HmShzxdSkfxq2d3jTvFiXAQovK_VI4ezniIn-todavo0bBhjIe4eDNk3DnmHcAIRGERKKCyQtZPlzTfjzuc7N2lEK7USM04NQLwPyA4RLCktLoQxDW0oYvn)

As Americans, we _deserve_ a new generation of leaders representing us in Congress. Leaders who understand the problems families all over the country are experiencing. Leaders who will fight for a strong economy, good paying jobs, affordable and high-quality healthcare, security and safety, education for our kids, and a better life for all Americans.

Many leaders in Congress right now have sold out our kid’s futures and put their own needs before the needs of constituents.

**The Marines taught me that teamwork is essential to the success of a mission, and a service-first mindset is fundamental.** Far too many folks in Washington are too busy playing partisan politics, instead of putting their heads down and doing the work of the people.

[**I promise you, as your next Representative in Washington, that I will commit to serving you and your family – because that’s what it’s all about right?**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e17469c3c5a649468217a51c73d673d5&_e=C-Kp7LH4qPqoK6swDAJngIKcRCk-vfnLA79670sMCVqN_UXLuFeRAZvS4lvaHwiG24hJiG9tMBL8To8-l7BGhpNG1lTxfHXJw0cNrGUx1bzViMh2J1brnEn1P-OyBh0D7RUO1OJhCL1N7ohjcI4wlqf-HJATV-sstku07KokNJMbXNOn75TbOdz6l7pHYOfHqxvTQ0yz7UsPIzk-6ggNTuB1T85BGG1CkmdlqnkRksLN1xp-xwyIFqXEF3Es0ewThRISQjfXIh2iYG_60NFivpOcqUewaFB1-ErFnVe9QubwXkz3GmofLTw3UPXPs9By8R-AAAmzRlN7F1MN8WeZQuuWhc6P6DTsxrYxKLnnaKvFGJA6yJzJw439pzRh0RLmE8XGFQQ863K6RWxCtwDQLKe1EF0KU_4h0SVLJn3cU7ov2U1WWQmuTW3dFf9O9uI5nlxT22uX58n3MrC7kozX2mInL_UU1tcscre_pnUj0k5iZVsZWFNR0tsUSUxnPZdo)

[**Will you support me today, so that I can make good on that promise, and be the change that Congress so desperately needs?**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e17469c3c5a649468217a51c73d673d5&_e=C-Kp7LH4qPqoK6swDAJngIKcRCk-vfnLA79670sMCVqN_UXLuFeRAZvS4lvaHwiG24hJiG9tMBL8To8-l7BGhpNG1lTxfHXJw0cNrGUx1bzViMh2J1brnEn1P-OyBh0D7RUO1OJhCL1N7ohjcI4wlqf-HJATV-sstku07KokNJMbXNOn75TbOdz6l7pHYOfHqxvTQ0yz7UsPIzk-6ggNTuB1T85BGG1CkmdlqnkRksLN1xp-xwyIFqXEF3Es0ewThRISQjfXIh2iYG_60NFivpOcqUewaFB1-ErFnVe9Quacn2YekcZ4G18Pnn5eUCXZf_2abIyU9J49IQmsFxpaQmSRSq488lCqXdeAq2EKswL_85zBQQ84I1NB7zRj9RBL2pgcG4aH9wArnIRHz0NYtv2ag5HFD1_7ND3piq47bei2DIhTjdR_SEIbZSDvT-_7Fl_8lmXtKemi-ZmOn1R160_5WAuIg4J_DGyLsjxwkpPKenuAyo8kQg0jzmb-ZuBh)

When I first ran for Congress in 2020, _no one_ thought I had a shot.

I was facing a well-funded Democrat who took checks from the likes of Nancy Pelosi, corporate PACs, and special interest donors. _**But sitting around doing nothing went against every instinct in my body.**_ With zero resources or experience, I narrowly lost to my opponent, coming within just two points.

After a tough race and an even tougher loss, I picked myself up and decided to try again. **The Marines taught me to jump in, resolve problems, take action, and to have the courage to try.**

If I’ve learned anything in my 34 years on this earth, it’s that failure often teaches us more than success. So, I’m failing forward. I’m giving this race all that I’ve got. [**And I’m asking that you support me on this mission.**](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=e17469c3c5a649468217a51c73d673d5&_e=C-Kp7LH4qPqoK6swDAJngIKcRCk-vfnLA79670sMCVqN_UXLuFeRAZvS4lvaHwiG24hJiG9tMBL8To8-l7BGhpNG1lTxfHXJw0cNrGUx1bzViMh2J1brnEn1P-OyBh0D7RUO1OJhCL1N7ohjcI4wlqf-HJATV-sstku07KokNJMbXNOn75TbOdz6l7pHYOfHqxvTQ0yz7UsPIzk-6ggNTuB1T85BGG1CkmdlqnkRksLN1xp-xwyIFqXEF3Es0ewThRISQjfXIh2iYG_60NFivpOcqUewaFB1-ErFnVe9QuZQhfxYcC8KdRWWt8BlnAOimeKmFFJ5wdpIBc-5Zr8pHHSD1wpVoiwliyt-OXEdOgRy8y0ZToLwRNMApfIgh4SYNsQZfj04AhoBx84MD53mv2_GquVyv9au5U8E2feX1f-7hFFxRXnbkgVh2yHaa10p8CmD1fEGm_DnrgerZLQvGZ0hqgEYiKUC-Kf793cfJ36D1ivfpeMfhuCIarzSqzn2)

I can guarantee you this – I will never give up on you. I will never stop fighting for what is right (not just what party-leadership says so). I will never sell out for my own personal interests. And **I will never stop defending this country that we both love**.

These are the same motivations that have driven me to run for Congress today. | Peter, When I was commissioned into the Marine Corps more than ten years ago, it was for a multitude of reasons. I was inspired to take action, protect our country, and answer a call for public service. I believed America was worth protecting, and I still do. As Americans, we deserve a new generation of leaders representing us in Congress. Leaders who understand the problems families all over the country are experiencing. Leaders who will fight for a strong economy, good paying jobs, affordable and high-quality healthcare, security and safety, education for our kids, and a better life for all Americans. Many leaders in Congress right now have sold out our kid’s futures and put their own needs before the needs of constituents. The Marines taught me that teamwork is essential to the success of a mission, and a service-first mindset is fundamental. Far too many folks in Washington are too busy playing partisan politics, instead of putting their heads down and doing the work of the people. When I first ran for Congress in 2020, no one thought I had a shot. I was facing a well-funded Democrat who took checks from the likes of Nancy Pelosi, corporate PACs, and special interest donors. But sitting around doing nothing went against every instinct in my body. With zero resources or experience, I narrowly lost to my opponent, coming within just two points. After a tough race and an even tougher loss, I picked myself up and decided to try again. The Marines taught me to jump in, resolve problems, take action, and to have the courage to try. If I’ve learned anything in my 34 years on this earth, it’s that failure often teaches us more than success. So, I’m failing forward. I’m giving this race all that I’ve got. ---
Friend, Three weeks ago, the radical-right Supreme Court overturned 49 years of precedent and revoked women's reproductive rights in America. The end of Roe v. Fellow American,

We’re only writing to you about this today, because quite frankly, it should get your blood boiling.

It’s pretty clear that Biden and his admin are waging an all-out assault on the oil and natural gas industry.

**First:** They cancelled the Keystone Excel Pipeline their first day in the White House
**Then:** Biden instructed his administration to cancel all drilling/fracking on federal lands
**Now:** President Biden is going to Saudi Arabia to beg their monarch to increase oil production to help relieve some pain at the pump.

**All the while, gas in Mexico is about $1 cheaper.** To add insult to injury, President Biden met with the Mexican president recently, where he was lectured for 30+ minutes on a multitude of subjects. He even boasted to President Biden that the Mexican government allows Americans to cross the border for gas since it’s $1 cheaper than in the U.S.

What kind of nonsense is that?

Fellow American - gas in Mexico should never be cheaper than in the U.S.

We’re embarrassed by President Biden – and you should be too.

Over the past several years it’s become increasingly clear **we can’t rely on the Supreme Court to protect our democracy**. It has gutted the Voting Rights Act and made a series of contradictory rulings on gerrymandering that seem to favor GOP map manipulators.

But the good news is our strategy has always been about way more than the Supreme Court. State courts will decide a number of important cases related to gerrymandering and voting rights in the future, which is why the GOP is desperately seeking to install justices who they think will rubber stamp their manipulated maps. [_We have a plan to fight back, but we need your help to do it._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47898984/356097147/1479146301?amount=20&refcode=20220715.3r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ3MWZkZTAwLWFiMDQtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LhPqHpW4Uxj_UhPVzZ7ZMbsbGS2FDz3uO-6xeYnzw6s=)

That plan includes targeting important races that will affect the future of our democracy across **17 different states this November** , including state supreme court elections, state legislative elections, and governor’s races. But all our work takes a significant amount of resources, which is why we’re reaching out right now.

**Our July mid-month deadline is at midnight tonight, and we’re still just a few donations short of our goal. Can you pitch in right now to put us over the top and help us keep up our work to protect our democracy?**

Florida’s 14th Congressional District**P.S.** I’ve got a real chance to defeat one of the furthest-left Democrats in Congress.Now that my name will surely be on the ballot, I need your support more than ever.[So, contribute generously to my Legal Defense Fund in this crucial time, when my campaign needs it the most](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=557416c79e&e=00028e5542).After you do that, I kindly ask that you forward this message to all of your patriotic friends and ask them to do the same!

Peter,

When I was commissioned into the Marine Corps more than ten years ago, it was for a multitude of reasons. I was inspired to take action, protect our country, and answer a call for public service. I believed America was worth protecting, _and I still do_.

[**These are the same motivations that have driven me to run for Congress today.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=5ac5d4a3be784af5a7ffc74ba964a673&_e=JSjVtbtRn8FDwuvF4GkHrsoZAZm2AxU09Ax5mjkY_merZC-ZPeRCmKjNlOWNSwdlb2cbT1mKCKQTeV4wGZANkctMcLTZKxTMZeJXqSmJYap52CpTwjO40WdTOdMnn8pnTbR8_Bt-AjrMZrQPN-fZnehD0pHYOOg4mdVlJ_KoJv-bCFBDEwwAnCgGPL-6qDo_Y0MZZpUBK_q6hSQPM99pfPHeISAxslXav6E3vdQF13-wpEM2iW9aFfXOPOEj9LB2431UCshygKIqIznohWmJJpCpPTUcgzJJB3YPg1kg3PGFMPHjrxkXt9Dgtj5Cr-KnAZY-Gm--5c3_Km9Zx-sld0nKtUF8QwD5GY1r_GLyhmOKrZmDf6RczN2_0lpeytq2xv5kR6DXwk61GoxUElturwz7b76tEt3jg2rFb357QvDeVU6CfS0hVsPEEyh_1LX3TpKA8Q_3YIvLkYr9jXooCS66XkyU4awWO1GPa88yte8klD8xCvMPo-bgOnk-7Thh)

Leaders who will fight for a strong economy, good paying jobs, affordable and high-quality healthcare, security and safety, education for our kids, and a better life for all Americans.

Many leaders in Congress right now have sold out our kid’s futures and put their own needs before the needs of constituents.

**The Marines taught me that teamwork is essential to the success of a mission, and a service-first mindset is fundamental.** Far too many folks in Washington are too busy playing partisan politics, instead of putting their heads down and doing the work of the people.

Leaders who will fight for a strong economy, good paying jobs, affordable and high-quality healthcare, security and safety, education for our kids, and a better life for all Americans. Many leaders in Congress right now have sold out our kid’s futures and put their own needs before the needs of constituents. The Marines taught me that teamwork is essential to the success of a mission, and a service-first mindset is fundamental. Far too many folks in Washington are too busy playing partisan politics, instead of putting their heads down and doing the work of the people. When I first ran for Congress in 2020, no one thought I had a shot. I was facing a well-funded Democrat who took checks from the likes of Nancy Pelosi, corporate PACs, and special interest donors. But sitting around doing nothing went against every instinct in my body. With zero resources or experience, I narrowly lost to my opponent, coming within just two points. After a tough race and an even tougher loss, I picked myself up and decided to try again. The Marines taught me to jump in, resolve problems, take action, and to have the courage to try. If I’ve learned anything in my 34 years on this earth, it’s that failure often teaches us more than success. So, I’m failing forward. I’m giving this race all that I’ve got. I can guarantee you this – I will never give up on you. I will never stop fighting for what is right (not just what party-leadership says so). I will never sell out for my own personal interests. And I will never stop defending this country that we both love. If that is worth something to you, In service, Tyler Kistner Father. Husband. Marine. P.S. – Our race is tough, our resources are low, and recent polling is shifting in favor of my opponent. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, this is
important:

Our campaign is currently $15,000 short from where we need to be to reach
our mid-month fundraising goal for July.

We’re relying on donations from emails like this to make sure we stay on
track with our fundraising and make sure our team has the funds we need to
replace Rand Paul.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220715.Oo3R7l&refcode=em20220715-2-2230&t=1001&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts ]Will you chip in $21.46 (our average donation) or anything you can
right now to help us hit our goal before midnight tomorrow? We’ll explain
later in this email why your support is more important than ever at this
critical moment for our campaign.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220715.Oo3R7l&refcode=em20220715-2-2230&t=1002&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts ]CHIP IN NOW →

Charles has been on the road with our team meeting voters across Kentucky
and spreading our message for bold, progressive change.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220715.Oo3R7l&refcode=em20220715-2-2230&t=1003&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts ][IMG]

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220715.Oo3R7l&refcode=em20220715-2-2230&t=1004&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts ][IMG]

We can feel the excitement on the ground to turn Kentucky blue. The
conversations we’re having with voters are the beginning of our work to
unite our Commonwealth and make sure we finally send someone to the U.S.
Senate who will fight for us.

If we want to win, we need to continue ramping up our voter outreach
efforts, planning more trips like this, and make sure our people power is
felt on Election Day.

But here’s the harsh reality we face: This kind of organizing work is
expensive. From training volunteers, paying for gas, and running our
political ads — there’s a lot of expenses ahead of our campaign. On top of
that, we need significant resources and funding to compete with the
corporate PAC and special interest money that has protected Rand’s seat.

It’s going to take a powerful, grassroots funded movement to organize and
mobilize enough folks to take back Kentucky’s seat at the table. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220715.Oo3R7l&refcode=em20220715-2-2230&t=1005&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts ]That’s
why we’re asking for your support right now. Please chip in $21.46 or
anything you can if you want to see us run and help us reach this critical
mid-month goal before our midnight deadline tomorrow.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18317?c0=20220715.Oo3R7l&refcode=em20220715-2-2230&t=1024&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts ]CHIP IN NOW →

Thank you,

Team Booker

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20220715-2230-footer&t=1025&refcode2=2230_346206_YBC4Ts&akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2230%2E346206%2EYBC4Ts

clean_body: We have to close our books at midnight. | Friend — I apologize for being so abrupt, but when the clock strikes midnight, we’ll have to submit our fundraising numbers with the Wisconsin Ethics Commission one last time before Election Day. But with YOUR help at the final hour, we can make Evers’ greatest fear a reality. Thank you for your support at this critical hour! \- Rebecca Sent from my iPhone \- - - - Forwarded Message - - - - From: Rebecca Kleefisch Date: Thu, July 14, 2022 Subject: Final Filing Deadline (7/15) To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, I can’t thank you enough for all the support you’ve given my family and me during this race. It’s because of grassroots patriots like YOU that I have all the confidence in the world we will secure the Republican nomination on August 9 and go on to FIRE Tony Evers in this toss-up governor’s race. But I have to ask for your help one last time before the FINAL filing deadline of the primary with the Wisconsin Ethics Commission TOMORROW at 11:59 P.M. With just $11,190 to go to hit our last mid-month goal, we’re racing against the clock. Tony Evers would give anything for us to miss this final deadline. He knows I’m the ONLY candidate polling within the margin of error of beating him in November. And he knows that if we fall short of our goal at this final cutoff, we could lose all the momentum we’ve built over the last couple of weeks. That’s why I’m counting on your support now more than ever, Friend. ## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---

|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

clean_body: | | | | | Salome Mulugeta Interview | | | | ---|--- | Salome Mulugata is an Ethiopian American journalist who reached out to Erik Aadland today. Watch the interview at the link below for a fascinating perspective on how Erik Aadland will navigate international relations, how other societies view the United States of America and our influence around the world. == | | Recorded Friday July 15, 2022 On Hello Ethiopia TV | == | | | | == | | About Erik | | | Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children. | About Aadland For Congress | | | Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors. You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.
